At 120% or more it caps at 120%. This is for stages. The post doesn't say whether Guild Conquest uses it.

sources.title: [📚정보] 스킬가속 정리
sources.summaryEn: Datamine of game version 1.1.002. Skill haste uses the LoL-style formula: final CD = base CD × 100/(100+haste). Only the root skill cooldown is hasted. Internal delays of multi-stage skills, such as child spawn delays and dash intervals, are not. That is why haste seems to work differently per cookie.

sources.title: [📚정보] 치명 관련 스탯 정리
sources.summaryEn: Datamine of the crit system. Crit rate above 100% gives tiered crits: 1st/2nd/3rd-degree crits, where the integer part is guaranteed and the fraction is the chance of the next tier. Crit multiplier = 1 + tier × (0.5 + bonus crit dmg). Past 100% effective crit rate, crit damage is worth more per point than crit rate. Sugar-rune max per line is 8% for both crit rate and crit damage.

sources.title: [📚정보] 띄우기 저항 작동 방식 정리
sources.summaryEn: Lift resistance shortens airborne time; it is not a chance to ignore the lift. Resistances combine multiplicatively, and a skill is cancelled if the cookie is airborne for 0.4 s or more. Base 20% + Pinot Noir 35% = 48%, and adding the Panda Dumpling pet's 20% gives 64%, so a 1 s lift drops to 0.36 s and no longer cancels skills. The OP also gives lift durations for several cookies.

sources.title: 장문) 크럼블던전 43G 공략, 우유 위치 컨트롤 팁
sources.titleEn: Long post: Crumble Dungeon 43G guide, controlling Milk's position
sources.summaryEn: Recommended guide by 스미노프TFT (server in the 100s, #1 in power but #4 in the dungeon before a week of testing). Result 43,193,915,016 at 3G 505M, 1st, 4.366 s left, with two roster screenshots. Rules: the top 40 by power fight first and earn nearly all the score; Cheesecake and Lime overwrite Milk's and Macaron's higher buffs, so leave them out; arena gear preset without accuracy or focus, built on Skill Haste, crit damage, crit rate and Skill AMP; Milk captain with Passion Pay and Rapid Promotion at mercenary Lv.4 (Rapid Promotion alone at Lv.3); ATK order Milk > Scorpion > Figure > other dealers, set by lowering levels, with Milk and Figure in the top three; tanks gain nothing from the beam. Supports above Lv.70 made Milk crawl in from the back, so supports stay at Lv.70 or below except Macaron and Milk; Red Pepper and Dark Cherry charge in, get hit, and Milk runs to heal them, reaching the centre at about 53 s. Spend about 1,000 sugar-rune crafts on minor dealers for damage lines. Comments: an app-player trick moved Milk by holding the up key (patched later); cookies outside the 40 join when the 40 die, but at high power everyone is wiped with 8 s left.

sources.title: 마카롱 공증안줘도 되는 이유가
sources.titleEn: Why Macaron doesn't need ATK runes
sources.summaryEn: Milk's ATK buff scales with Milk's own ATK, not the target's. Scorpion ~300k ATK → 1.4M with Milk's buff → 3M if Milk has Cheesecake's buff too. So dealer levels matter little; skill amp is for damage, ATK amp only helps survival/straw targeting. Debate: ATK runes on Macaron are for guaranteeing Pomegranate's straw; alternative is lowering others' levels (e.g., to ~70 at Seeker 6★).

sources.title: 장비 선택 팁 준다

sources.summaryEn: Full gear tables: main stat per slot, rarity multipliers, plate enhancement bonus (+0 to +20), sub-option count by rarity, and sub-option ranges per slot group. Skill haste appears only as a sub-option on accessories, at flat 1–2 per line before enhancement. Skill amp is a sub-option on weapons and attack accessories and the main stat of the Book (책).

sources.title: 토벌에서 렙낮추고 체리맛넣고 똥꼬쇼 하는 이유가 머임?

sources.summaryEn: Explanation: lowering levels sets ATK order for Pomegranate targeting; Cherry is inserted between Macaron and Seeker so they line up. After the Cheesecake lottery died, Macaron single-line works without Cherry; one commenter says Cherry was 'mostly a scam from the start'.

sources.title: 200g클럽

Pomegranate's 3-buff went to 우/피/브/전/마. Low levels on Dark Choco/Pinot/Herb are to steer Pomegranate; exact-level tuning also works but Milk stack differences sometimes break it. sources.title: 길토 비법소스 찾은듯?
sources.summaryEn: After the Cheesecake-buff fix, move speed raised his peak ~100G. Level adjustment + move speed runes produce the single-file line (Macaron getting buffs while dodging Cheesecake) without Cherry and without infinite retries. Author ~1.5 total move speed; too much breaks placement. Candy Apple: controlling via move speed beats infinite retries on bad placement; 1 gear line is always worth it. Patch detail: Cheesecake used to overwrite Milk's buff; now Milk's stacked buff no longer gets overwritten when higher, raising lottery odds.

sources.title: [📚정보] 슈가룬 요약(토벌전 기준)
sources.summaryEn: Sugar-rune optimizer output from the 65772 calculator for a 12-cookie conquest team where Pomegranate buffs 5 targets. It assumes Macaron, Milk (buffed by Cheesecake), Figure and Ceylon buffs always land. Milk goes all ATK%, Pomegranate all skill amp, and Cheesecake and Figure all skill amp. Macaron and Ceylon get just enough ATK% to enter Pomegranate's top-5, with the rest in skill amp. Dealers that receive Pomegranate's buff go all crit (crit dmg at 10 Macaron stacks, crit rate at 5 or 0 stacks); dealers that don't go all skill amp. The recommended runes roughly double the calculated damage.

sources.title: 토벌전 현시점 빌드 2개 소개한다
sources.summaryEn: As of 9/17: skill-amp Macaron build gives ~300–400x team power if you can survive the 30 s slam (lvl-down others still reaches 17 s); ATK-amp Macaron build gives ~150–300x and is the stable fallback for weaker accounts that can't survive 30 s. Rule: if you reach 17 s with a skill-amp setup, skill amp is the ceiling; if not, ATK amp is.

sources.title: [일반] 100배도 안뽑히는데 어케하노
sources.titleEn: Can't even pull 100x, what do I do
sources.summaryEn: Confirms the fight doesn't require surviving to a checkpoint to score: a commenter reports a full wipe still scoring over 100x, since damage already dealt before death still counts. Score is framed as run-to-run RNG requiring many retries (매크로).

sources.title: 공증단 250배
sources.summaryEn: Author settles on ATK-amp runes (250x) rather than swapping ATK/skill-amp for raid; notes skill-amp setup still scores higher. Nobody had survived 17 s at 9/17 even heavy spenders (max ~3G power).

sources.title: [일반] 17초에 안죽으려면 투력 몇정도임?
sources.titleEn: How much power to not die at 17s?
sources.summaryEn: As of 9/17, even accounts at 2.2G team power still die at the 17 s super-jump — confirms that on this date nobody (including high-power accounts) had cracked survival yet.

sources.title: 400배
sources.summaryEn: 659G 961M at 1.49G (~443x), deck 5; no move speed; everything Lv100 except Cherry Lv1 (stage-pushing) — says to level down Pinot, Dark Choco, Herb for raid; gave some extra haste to Dark Choco/Pinot/Cheesecake. Top guilds that day: 6T 23G / 5T 452G / 3T 953G. This is the post referenced for '280M → 16G'.

sources.title: 토벌전 투력 300M대로 6G 내면 병신인건가?
sources.summaryEn: Low-power calibration thread: 6G at ~300M with no lv4 mercenary; replies: 250M → 10G with infinite retries and no ATK-order; 280M → 16G; 'should be 15–20G even without surviving 30 s'; 400M with mercenary lv3 → 45G with 1–2 surviving 30 s.

sources.title: [일반] 토벌전 17초
sources.summaryEn: OP at 900M deck power asks who is surviving past 17s; no replies. Corroborates that survival was still considered a high-spec-only feat in mid-September.

sources.title: [📚정보] 470배클럽 + faq
sources.summaryEn: Group #1 player 캔디애플 (guild 탄산수맛쿠키) posts three Pinata raid decks at ~1.03-1.05G team power scoring 455G, 470.5G and 561.9G (≈442x/448x/540x) with a Seeker at only 5★, plus an FAQ on sugar runes, perks (20%/7% = 열정페이+초고속승진), ATK order and why filler cookies are Lv.1. The later, stronger deck is a Melon Soda + Jungle Warrior deck with move speed (이속) sugar-rune lines only on Pinot Noir to control arrival order/positioning. The 129-comment thread covers move-speed micro-tuning, Milk dying at ~24s (fix: use Herb), and Scorpion stealing Pomegranate's buff.

sources.title: 토벌 용병3렙 100배 공략
sources.summaryEn: 46G 916M at 403.19M (~116x). ATK order 우유 > 시커 > 피겨 > 전갈 > 마카롱 > 실론나이트 > 치즈케이크 (character-select screen values). Herb vs JW irrelevant since all die at 30 s; JW's first buff on Pomegranate lets 실론 get the buff and give a strong 8 s ATK buff. All runes skill amp except Milk; Pinot must have zero move speed (0.5 makes it run ahead and get interrupted). Candy Apple disagrees: 2 high move-speed lines (1.05) on Pinot is much better in the Melon deck.

sources.title: 토벌 60배
sources.summaryEn: 14,657,991,631 (14.66G) at 254.47M (~58x), mercenary lv3; cherry deck felt more stable than melon; dies right after 30 s (battle over at timer 27.900). Herb (green) at Lv1. ATK order written 우브피석치, corrected by commenter to 우브피마치 (Macaron, not Pomegranate).

sources.title: 크럼블 던전 총투 28배
sources.summaryEn: Lobby: 전치 1st on the weekly board with 105G 173M at 3.74G, Skill Haste preset ('스킬가속셋'), weekly close in 6 days 2 hours. ATK order '우브전피마치': Milk, Brightseeker, Scorpion, Figure, Macaron, Cheesecake. Devil added on the guess that its DEF shred no longer overlaps Dark Choco's.

sources.title: TSSR 안쓰는 아레나덱 이거 어떰?
sources.titleEn: An Arena deck with no TSSR
sources.summaryEn: 8.55M no-TSSR deck (Macaron, Donut, Cheesecake, Grapevine, Milk, Crepe / Rye, Pinot, Pomegranate, Espresso, Hound, Herb); pets Holy Baby 20, Icy Birdie 18, Chargemellow 16. 12-hour defense log is almost all wins against Wind Archer/Macaron/Seeker/Rye decks; normal win rate 50-60%; GM3 to Master 1. Rye and Espresso need 5★; Skill Haste 3.4 on six lines; ATK order Milk–Espresso–Macaron–Rye.

sources.title: 회피덱으로 그마 찍튀 성공
sources.titleEn: Touched Grand Master with an evasion deck
sources.summaryEn: Same player, earlier: 9.69M evasion deck, same lineup as 72977 (Pinot Noir, Pomegranate, Lime, Hound, Crepe in the bottom row). Pets Mango Toucan 20, Holy Baby Drop 20, Hot Doggie 18. Picked targets under 10M, sometimes beats 11M, but loses to 7M decks with accuracy. Evasion runes only on Ion, Hound, Vampire (2-3 lines); gear evasion+crit RES and evasion+skill haste; upper right Focus + Skill Haste. Evasion ~1000 without max plates.

sources.title: [일반] 용병단 4 여니까 체감 좋노
sources.summaryEn: Mercenary band level 4 adds no displayed power but a big felt difference; Passion Pay and All Ammo Provided perks praised.

sources.title: [✋️질문] 형들 하루에 투력 얼마나 올려?
sources.titleEn: How much power do you gain per day?
sources.summaryEn: Daily growth reports: about 50M/day, 100M on days with key purchases and mileage, at about 800M power while Eternal gear is opening; one claims 500M in a day; late-server players get many pulls.

sources.title: 본인 2g 다되가는데 토벌전 17초 1마리 버팀

sources.summaryEn: In-battle stat screen: Dark Choco SSR HP 8M 942K, crit res 132.23%, dmg reduction 54.07%, skill amp 213.20%, crit rate 352.48%, crit dmg 392.15%, move speed 4, haste 31.6 — survived the 17 s slam with a sliver. Author estimates >10M HP needed for others to survive.

sources.summaryEn: Account snapshots near 1G team power: Fame 98 / Resolve 770; 1.5G at Fame 120 / Resolve 840; Fame 103 / Resolve 765; 1.03G at Fame 103 / Resolve 821.

sources.title: 이게 ㄹㅇ 고점같은데
sources.summaryEn: Candy Apple (캔디애플, guild 탄산수맛쿠키, rank-1 guild) posts 462G 534M at 1.03G (~449x) with the cherry deck plus Jungle Warrior / 실론 buff chain. Lv.1 cookies (Scorpion, Pinot, JW, Cherry) and Dark Choco at Lv43 exist only so Pomegranate doesn't pick them; Cherry is included purely for formation. ATK order 우브피실마치. Priority list of damage factors given. 265 comments.

sources.title: 500배 클럽 좀있으면 갈듯
sources.summaryEn: Candy Apple: 470,505,950,005 (470.5G), battle ended at 17.233, guild 1st (4T 337G). Cherry + Jungle Warrior is great but finding the right 'world-line' is very hard. All move speed removed from all 12 cookies' gear and runes. Lists the world-lines to hunt: Seeker+Macaron; fast Pomegranate 2- or 3-buff; Scorpion+Macaron; 실론+Pomegranate; alternating 실론/전갈. JW has no haste. Milk survives past 27 s. A buff can land as early as 53 s.

sources.title: [일반] 스가5 1줄 기댓값얼마임?
sources.titleEn: Expected cost of one Skill Haste 5 rune line
sources.summaryEn: One top-tier Skill Haste line is a 1/6,524 roll; three such lines take about 85,000 Rune Crystals.

sources.title: 카페 길드 얘네
sources.summaryEn: The author asks what 카페's secret is, since their scores are in a different league. Commenters guess they beat the 17 s wall ('Dark Choco survived', per a post below it), which 켈트 denies. Another says Carpediem's whales all moved to 카페.

sources.title: 토벌딜 꿀통 푼다
sources.summaryEn: An anonymous claim: players hitting 400–600× have highly enhanced weapons and high breakthrough power (돌파력), and 돌파력 applies in conquest.

sources.title: 내가 쓰는건 이거긴함
sources.summaryEn: Cherry deck: ATK order 우유 시커 마카롱 피겨 치케 실론; no move speed; infinite retries; JW instead of Herb. Macaron and Cheesecake all skill amp; Seeker all-haste vs mixed is debated, mixing some skill amp doesn't wreck damage. All die at 17 s. 450–500x achievable; 600x is spec. Commenter: 1T players have nearly all-SSR sugar runes; buffers' runes matter most (Pomegranate, Milk, then Cheesecake/Macaron/피겨/실론); with Wasabi pet Seeker doesn't need all haste.

sources.title: 토벌 17초 이후로도 버틸수있나 한번해봤는데
sources.titleEn: Tried whether you can survive past 17 s
sources.summaryEn: The in-battle stat screen shows Bright Seeker (TSSR) at HP 9M 404K, ATK 1M 418K, DEF 364K, crit rate 202.10%, crit dmg 211.44%, crit res 119.03%, DR 45.64% and move speed 3.5. The Seeker reliably survives the 17 s wipe to about 9 s, while Dark Choco and the ATK-tuned cookies (~5M HP) do not. The author used the 왕방울 and 얼음새 pets for the test, plus Hot Dog on the front line. A commenter says 카페 (the #1 guild) earlier published a video near 1T that did NOT survive 17 s, and speculates their later growth comes from dealers surviving 17 s for extra poison and drone damage.

sources.title: [일반] 35% 잡스테에서 다들 이렇게하지?
sources.titleEn: Everyone does this on 35% mob stages, right?

sources.titleEn: Not sure about Focus, but Accuracy is not a scam

sources.titleEn: Should F2P just get Stellar Link above 90?
sources.summaryEn: F2P route: 39% with 3 points open, a square at 4, a regular hexagon at 6, then 95% once 10 are open; or the 91% octagon, spending leftovers on a decagon at constellations 7–8.

sources.title: 시발 기갱페이스였는데
sources.titleEn: Damn, it was on record pace (the author's 다발 2 / 다발 3 retry checklist is in the comments)
sources.summaryEn: Milk dies at the 30 s slam after ~1000 attempts. In the comment thread the author gives concrete diagnostic checkpoints top players use to judge whether a run's positioning/buff-landing is good: whether Brightseeker and Macaron keep receiving every buff to the end, and elapsed-time deadlines for Pomegranate's beam-count upgrades.

sources.title: 크럼블던전 우유 빨리나오네
sources.titleEn: Milk comes out fast in Crumble Dungeon
sources.summaryEn: One move-speed line added to the arena preset and Milk now arrives fast, deck unchanged; a reply: scores are high when Milk arrives early and low when late.

sources.title: [일반] 300m따리 토벌
sources.summaryEn: At 300M power, at most 5-6 of 12 cookies survive the 30 s slam and Milk dies to it every time; scores land around 7-20G depending on ATK-order/rune choices.

sources.title: 드디어 토벌 기갱했다 410배 후
sources.summaryEn: Went from ~150x to 300–400x just by removing move speed from gear. Result 594,468,439,582 at 1.41G (level-downed) ≈ 421x, battle ended at timer 17.233. Only move speed kept: Pinot 1 line, Seeker 0.39 — then 전갈/호밀/시커 line up in front of Macaron without Cherry. ATK order 우유 브시 피겨 마카 치즈; 호밀 Lv20, 전갈 Lv40; 실론 정전 닥초 피노 Lv1 (they were stealing skill-amp buffs); low levels don't change survival time.

sources.title: [📚정보] 168 이후 All In One 단일 덱 및 보스별 스위칭 공유
sources.titleEn: [Info] Post-168 all-in-one deck and per-boss switches (story stages)
sources.summaryEn: Story-stage (not Guild Conquest) all-in-one deck guide at ~816–862M power with pet swaps per boss. Relevant shared rule: leader Milk + 열정페이, and Milk must be #1 in displayed ATK (author lowers 피겨 and 체리콜라 by 1–2 levels to guarantee it). Banner image confirms 피노누아맛 쿠키 and 체리콜라맛 쿠키 are SSR and 브라이트시커 is TSSR.

sources.title: [일반] 스텔라랑 돌파력 장비가 뻥투력이 엄청나네 ㅋㅋㅋㅋ
sources.titleEn: Stellar, Resolve and gear inflate power a lot
sources.summaryEn: A new player out-powered by someone ten stages behind worked Stellar, Resolve and gear and more than doubled power at once. Reply: Resolve rises very easily with gold while it is low.

sources.title: [일반] 스테이지 패스 안사길 잘한듯
sources.titleEn: Glad I didn't buy the stage pass (yet)
sources.summaryEn: The stage pass pays coin auto-hunt hours, which scale with the current stage, so buying it later gives more coins.

sources.title: [일반] 펫뽑이 진짜 할 이유가 없어보이네
sources.summaryEn: Pet stars do not count for Stellar Link, so pet pulls only add small holding effects.

sources.title: 누가 정전 스가 줘보래서 줘봄
sources.summaryEn: Candy Apple: gave JW 10 haste; new record 572,544,361,088 (572.5G) at 1.12G (~511x, author says 520x) with Melon Soda deck; floor rose noticeably. Battle ended at 17.233 s. Discussion: JW skill CD 10 s vs synergy 7 s, so ~50 haste could keep Pomegranate's 6-straw uptime; retry until JW casts while Pomegranate is in range after knockback.

sources.title: [일반] 토벌 30초에 자꾸 다 죽음
sources.titleEn: Guild Conquest: everyone keeps dying at 30s
sources.summaryEn: Active thread on the 30 s slam threshold: commenters converge on roughly 3-4M HP as the survival floor ('anything below one-shots'), mercenary Lv4 as a prerequisite, and report run-to-run variance at fixed power (two failures then a 30s-clear that jumped score ~2x, followed by ten more failures at the same build).

sources.title: [일반] 1렙 준 애들은 30초 쿵찍에 무조건 뒤지네
sources.titleEn: Lv.1 fillers always die to the 30s slam
sources.summaryEn: Commenters give row-specific HP thresholds for the 30 s slam: back row ~3.5M, front row ~4.5M as the floor.

sources.title: [일반] 이거 사야되는 우선순위가 머임?
sources.titleEn: What order to buy in the exchange?
sources.summaryEn: Exchange order: Syrup Metal, Stellar Points, Chocosteel (hard to get), then pickup cutters, sugar runes, pickup pet tickets.

sources.title: 900m 370배
sources.summaryEn: 334G 156M at 900.2M power (~371x), cherry-style deck; Jungle Warrior given haste, Pinot given move speed runes. Author only had gear haste; Seeker 4/4/3 haste. Candy Apple comment: in Melon deck also give move speed: Pinot 4.33, Melon Soda 4.71 (absolute speed values). Top guilds at the time 4T 79G / 3T 831G / 3T 510G.

sources.title: 450배 쳤는데 소소한 팁
sources.summaryEn: Tips: all-haste runes on Pinot Noir raised score (fewer knockbacks during the slam, author guesses); cherry deck ceiling ~300x in his view, auto players should use Melon Soda deck; Bright Seeker at 55 haste outperformed 45 haste — just stack haste rather than mixing skill amp. Commenter objects Pinot's lift-resist skill has 9.5 s CD and 10 s duration so haste is pointless.

sources.title: 2시간 손리트했는데
sources.titleEn: Two hours of manual retries (+16G, by the 1T 999G author)

sources.title: [일반] 와 진짜 10각한다고 존버타는게 병신짓이였네
sources.titleEn: Waiting for the decagon was a mistake
sources.summaryEn: 12-point 94% has the same probability as 10-point 95%, so outside the 8-point bargain there is no reason to wait at 10; replies say 10-point 95% is for Stellar 7, which takes long to open further.

sources.title: 크럼블던전 왜 하루에 열쇠 9개씩 줌?
sources.summaryEn: The key counter reads 9 over the cap; replies: keys bought in the mileage shop plus unspent ones carry over.

sources.title: [✋️질문] 토벌 우유 질문
sources.titleEn: Question about Milk in Guild Conquest
sources.summaryEn: OP's Milk dies specifically to the 30s slam ('30초 내려찍기') while Lv.1 fillers survive, apparently because Milk is busy healing others during that window and receives no heal herself, leaving the team without her ATK buff from 28s down to the 17s wipe.

sources.title: 토벌 정전vs허브는 체방 구간마다 다 다름
sources.titleEn: JW vs Herb depends on your HP/DEF bracket
sources.summaryEn: If everyone dies at 30 s anyway, JW has the higher ceiling. What matters is whether you survive 30→17 s without Herb; Milk sits mid-front and loses 20% HP, dies easily — then Herb scores better since Herb keeps all 12 alive. If you survive 30→17 without Herb, JW is again the ceiling, but JW's longer buff interval and range far from Pomegranate need more retries.

sources.title: 우리 섭 1등이 비겁 상대할 때 오방 좋다는데
sources.titleEn: Our #1 says Oven is good (vs Cowardly boss) and in Arena
sources.summaryEn: Server #1 put Oven Wanderer in his Arena deck to pull Espresso's skill away. Mostly about the Cowardly Cookie boss.

sources.title: 아레나덱 괜찮은 거 없나
sources.summaryEn: Pre-Bari: poster notes you lose when Milk runs forward to heal. Reply shares a 5-ranged 'spear' deck: Princess(?)/바궁 (Wind Archer), Macaron, Seeker, Rye, Donut, Milky Way, Pinot, Cheesecake, Pomegranate, Espresso, Milk, Hound; pets Holy Baby Drop, Hot Doggie, Icy Birdie (or King Choco); perks Passion Pay + All Ammo Provided (5 ranged). Pomegranate buff to Espresso and Wind Archer. Milk goes front; you win by killing their Milk first or polymorphing it.

sources.title: [일반] 토벌전 석류도 공격력 순서있는거임?

sources.title: [일반] 토벌 이게 국룰임?

sources.title: [✋️질문] 토벌 체리덱

sources.title: [일반] 토벌전 소년가장 뉴비 도와주실 고수님 구합니다ㅠ

sources.title: [일반] 토벌전 보스 시간 지날수록 피감 늘어남
sources.titleEn: The Guild Conquest boss's damage reduction rises over time
sources.summaryEn: The same author as dc:67285/67299 posts a refined datamine: boss damage reduction runs through 6 stages (10/30/50/70/90/99%) starting at 0% at fight start, upgrading first at 10s elapsed then every 12s after; boss ATK (offense stat) also jumps by orders of magnitude at each of the same stage boundaries. The 99% stage is never reached because the fight is only 60s long. This is the single most load-bearing (if unverified) post for the fight's difficulty curve.

sources.title: [일반] 토벌 이게 200배 맞음?

sources.title: 아레나 1등 이기는 방법 질문...
sources.titleEn: How do I beat my server's Arena #1?
sources.summaryEn: Pre-Bari meta. Server #1 (14.58M, 3,911 trophies) runs Wind Archer, Macaron, Milky Way, Brightseeker, Rye, Donut, Pinot Noir, Cheesecake, Pomegranate, Milk, Hound, Herb with pets Chargemellow, Holy Baby Drop, King Choco Drop. Poster's 16.6M deck (Macaron, Rye, Pinot, Pomegranate, Hound, Crepe, Seeker, Donut, Cheesecake, Milk, Ion Lv94, Herb) keeps losing. Advice: gear crit rate over crit damage because opponents run crit RES; drop Seeker/Herb for Bari and Espresso (5 ranged); swap the Rapid Fire pet for a DR pet.

sources.title: 크럼블던전 128G (투력26배)
sources.summaryEn: Result 128,745,164,292 at 4G 846M, 5th on the server (2nd Seed 161.92G), 5.566 s left; roster screens with levels; a mid-fight frame at 27.767 s left reading 80.3G. ATK order Milk, Scorpion, Figure, Melon Soda, Witchberry, Brightseeker (swapping Scorpion and Brightseeker scores higher); perks ATK 20% and '5사격'; gear Skill AMP and Skill Haste; arena preset. The two things that matter: whether Milk joins the main body at the start, and whether Cheesecake's ATK buff reaches Milk. Put Strawberry Crepe in for Angel. Comment: 159G after swapping Cheerleader for Moon Rabbit, likely helped by an eighth constellation.

sources.title: [일반] 크럼블 우유 무조건 앞으로 보내는 법 깨달았다
sources.titleEn: Found a way to always push Milk to the front
sources.summaryEn: Removing every backline support/healer (Herb, Rockstar, Lime, Angel, bird-pet-cookie etc, or setting their power to Lv.1 so they can't spawn) forces Milk to charge all the way to melee contact with the boss, because nothing is left behind her to stop the advance. Confirms formation resolves as a straight run-in that stops on first blocking ally/collision, not a scripted stop point; over-optimizing it can wipe the team too early, capping score.

sources.titleEn: If the opponent runs evasion + DR
sources.summaryEn: If defenders run evasion, attackers can switch to stage gear (with accuracy). It becomes rock-paper-scissors, but you can't see the opponent's gear before attacking. In Rumble names are hidden, so you can't remember who runs evasion.

sources.title: 시커 10성도 올스가야?
sources.titleEn: Is 10★ Seeker also all skill haste?
sources.summaryEn: Same Bright Seeker rune as 72951 (8 lines) with 치확 5.40%, 치피 8.00% and C 저항확률 lines unlocked. Author computes that rolling those 3 lines to 스가 +4 would bring raid/arena 스가 to 61.6. No replies.

sources.title: 니들 와레나 상점 조심해라
sources.summaryEn: The Rumble Arena shop (와글와글 아레나 상점) sells time-skip items for 350–500 Rumble medals (gems, XP, gold, dough, 3-key bundles, 5–10 per reset). Tickets cost 1,000 mileage each and can be bought without limit; the poster bought the maximum by mistake and spent all his mileage.

sources.title: [안내] 9월 23일(수) 확인된 현상 안내
sources.summaryEn: Official notice: the maximum number of Rumble Arena tickets was displayed wrongly. The display was only cosmetic; holding, refilling and spending tickets worked normally.

sources.title: [일반] 축복7) 바리로 확실해졌노 이겜은 돈지르는게 병신
sources.titleEn: Blessing 7: spending past the basics is a waste
sources.summaryEn: A blessing-7 spender: Ad Removal and the permanent packs are worth it, TSSRs and Chocosteel are not; SSRs at 8★ reach the end of all content.

sources.title: 바리오방덱 참고만 ㄱㄱ
sources.summaryEn: Regular Arena season 5 win, 14.2M vs 15.17M: Bari 2.09M, Oven 1.93M, Crepe 655K, Pinot 183K. Lineup: Macaron, Pinot, Pomegranate, Bari, Ion, Herb / Oven, Cheesecake, Donut?, Milk, Crepe, Moon Rabbit (from the bottom bar). The opponent was a Milky Way/Wind Archer/Seeker ranged deck.

sources.title: 와레나 미션 하루컷
sources.titleEn: Finished the Rumble missions in one day
sources.summaryEn: All 20 event missions done on day 1 by buying tickets with mileage. A commenter bought 40 tickets just to touch 2,000 pts.

sources.title: [✋️질문] 주간열쇠랑 크럼블패스만 사도 ㄱㅊ하지?
sources.titleEn: Only weekly keys and the Crumble Pass OK?
sources.summaryEn: Add the 55,000 KRW permanent pack if playing two months or more: its +1 daily dungeon entry matters more than its pulls.

sources.title: 와레나 덱 이거 까먹지마라
sources.titleEn: Don't forget this for your Rumble deck
sources.summaryEn: Reminder to swap gear from the stage preset to the arena preset. The poster kept losing to equal-power opponents while still on the stage set.

sources.title: 떡토끼 10성 + 바리 3성으로 랭킹 1위상대로 퍼펙트승리
sources.titleEn: Moon Rabbit 10★ + Bari 3★: perfect win over rank #1
sources.summaryEn: Launch-day report: server #1 (all cookies 10★) beaten flawlessly. Moon Rabbit 10★ (runes Focus, Skill Haste, HP, DR at SR+) hit the enemy Milk with its ATK-down and crit-rate-down, crippling Milk's buff and Seeker's drones; 10★ Cherry Cola and Bari tore the 10★ Milk apart. Gear: the usual Skill Haste/Skill AMP/evasion arena set. Pets Eggbeak, a tank-evasion pet (+18%: Breadog), Holy Baby Drop. Passion Pay had lowered the enemy Milk's HP.

sources.title: 와레나 씨발 뭐하는 컨텐츠냐
sources.summaryEn: A 10M player lost to a 5M one. Replies point to charge decks with the +30% HP buff, and to the arena gear preset versus the stage preset.

sources.title: [📚정보] 변경된 권장 전투력 및 신규 컨텐츠 전투력 반영
sources.titleEn: Changed recommended power and new-content power added (calculator)

sources.title: 와레나 교환소 개쳐맛있네
sources.summaryEn: The Rumble exchange sells dough-dungeon and coin-dungeon keys (10 per reset), which are the best value. 76393 recommends keys first (dough > gold > XP), then Stella rune auto-rewards, after chocolate bars and syrup.

sources.title: 와레나 랭커들 왜 바리안쓰노아무도 달토끼랑
sources.titleEn: Why don't Rumble rankers use Bari and Moon Rabbit?
sources.summaryEn: Commenters explain Moon Rabbit. It gets blocked in front by cookies that dive in, like Charles or Ion, so it often can't reach the backline. But landing its ATK-down on Milk alone pays for the slot: Milk's ATK buff collapses and the whole enemy damage line drops.

sources.title: [일반] 권투력 이사이트 반영됐네
sources.titleEn: Recommended power updated on this site

sources.title: 와글아레나 지면 포인트 안주지?
sources.titleEn: No points for losing in Rumble?
sources.summaryEn: The question implies attack losses give no reward points; nobody answered. 74344 shows a −5 score drop on a loss at rank 3.

sources.title: 와레나 2등의 오방덱 ㄷㄷ
sources.summaryEn: Leaderboard on day 1 (09-23 17:42): 1 검은반장 2,537 (12 Lv.100 cookies), 2 타미 2,504 (12), 3 섬영 2,442 (9 cookies plus 3 empty slots). Pets are Lv.20. A commenter notes the #1 team had no Charge cookie despite the Charge buff. Another says Skill Haste on Oven makes it rush out alone before the buffs land.

sources.title: 지금 아레나는 연타호밀덱이 1티어야?
sources.titleEn: Is the Rapid Fire Rye deck tier 1?
sources.summaryEn: Reply: it's rock-paper-scissors, there is no tier 1.

sources.title: 와글버프가 돌격형 체30%증가네
sources.summaryEn: Reports the season buff: Charge cookies get +30% max HP, which explains why Bari is strong. A commenter says the buff changes each season.

sources.title: 아레나 장비는 무조건 닥 스증스가임?
sources.titleEn: Arena gear is always Skill AMP + Skill Haste?
sources.summaryEn: Replies: crit DMG is good, crit rate less so, swap if the power gap is big; another says Arena is always 6 Skill Haste.

sources.title: [✋️질문] 7스텔라 8별91%인데 10별95% 안가면 많이 꼬움?
sources.summaryEn: With 9,000 Stellar Points, 91% → 95% is recommended as a realistic end; 100% would take about 150,000; one spent 5,000 and landed 92%, another 20,000 without 95%.

sources.title: 와레나 이런버프가 있었다고?
sources.summaryEn: An in-game screenshot of the 와글와글 버프 panel for Season 1 lists two buffs. The first is 'Charge cookie max HP +30%', with the eligible Charge cookies listed. The second is 'All cookies and summons DMG Reduction +30%'. The season-end timer read 14d 17h 11m on 09-23 18:49 KST.

sources.title: 와레나 바리덱 후기
sources.summaryEn: 설화 (then #4, 2,521 pts) runs Bari + Strawberry Crepe + Cherry Cola + Doughnut King + Macaron + Moon Rabbit + Hound + Ion. It crushes Bari+Oven decks but gets beaten by any deck with Rye. It beat the then-#1 Bari deck (while 2M lower). It can't beat a Brightseeker/Pinot/Rye/Macaron/Doughnut/Hound/Moon Rabbit/Ion deck even when 2M higher. The leaderboard screenshot shows the top 5 on 09-23 18:52: ㄹㄹ노아 2,614, 타미 2,594, 워터원 2,540, 설화 2,521, 검은반장 2,517.

sources.title: 와레나 마스터턱걸이가니까 떡벽씹고래새끼들뿐이네
sources.titleEn: Only whales at the Master threshold
sources.summaryEn: At the edge of Master League the opponents are all whales, so the poster will settle in Diamond 1 (다1). A commenter expects him to slide toward the Platinum threshold (플레).

sources.title: 사탄의 혈육 회슝좍
sources.summaryEn: Battle stats of a Bari 10★ evasion deck: Bari 1.60M, Cherry Cola 728K, Brightseeker 679K, Vampire 193K, Moon Rabbit, Donut, Pinot, Skating Queen; and Cherry Cola 1.93M / Bari 1.43M in another. All day of MISS.

sources.title: 와레나 123 다 오방이네
sources.titleEn: Rumble top 3 all run Oven Wanderer
sources.summaryEn: On day 1 the top 3 all ran Oven Wanderer. The poster says it only works with the TSSR support cookie (Bari) and the season buff.

sources.title: 와레나 260판 후기
sources.summaryEn: After 260 fights with a 12.12M Rye/Espresso ranged deck, the poster reports luck-dependent wins up to 20M and a ceiling of about 1,900 pts at 12M. Espresso fights on the front line, which makes the deck weak to Moon Rabbit. When Pomegranate's buff lands on Macaron, Macaron keeps about 300 crit even under Moon Rabbit. Pinot is kept at Lv.99 deliberately so that Pomegranate targets Macaron. The screenshot shows a +6 win value against a 14.23M, 1,572-pt defense.

sources.title: pvp랑 토벌이랑 장비 골자는 비슷함?
sources.titleEn: Are PvP and raid gear basically the same?
sources.summaryEn: Short Q; commenter says arena-attack and raid can share gear, plus one extra arena evasion defence preset. Follow-up about which slot (bottom-left or bottom-right) gets evasion went unanswered.

sources.title: [일반] 플레이트 뻥투력 ㅈ되는부위가 어디임
sources.summaryEn: For displayed power: weapons (sword, bow, staff), the armor; crit resistance is the best stat for power per line.

sources.title: 와글패스도 반필수임?
sources.summaryEn: A paid Rumble pass exists (19,000 KRW per 73476). Players are unsure whether it's needed to empty the Rumble shop.

sources.title: (예능) 와레나 언더독 법사덱
sources.summaryEn: A 12.28M Wizard (마법사맛 쿠키) deck tested over about 100 fights. It reliably beats equal-power teams and teams 2–3M stronger, and wins most bigger gaps if it survives the first 10 seconds. Early-sweep Bari decks kill it instantly. Strawberry Crepe can be swapped for Ion; Crepe wins more against Moon Rabbit. In the damage charts Wizard does 1.75–2.33M per fight and out-damages everything, beating Brightseeker, Rye, Espresso and Wind Archer decks of 17–21M.

sources.title: 아니 ㅁㅊ 아레나랑 와레나 장난하냐
sources.titleEn: Arena and Rumble are messing with me
sources.summaryEn: Defense records and defense rewards only update after relogging; points update immediately.

sources.title: 복숭아 넣은 회슝좍덱 써본 후기
sources.summaryEn: 16.51M evasion deck built around Bari with Peach and Vampire, evasion ~900 in dungeon. Beat a 21.43M team (Rumble screen): Bari 3.54M, Cherry Cola 758K, Peach 312K. Against unprepared decks the power gap is meaningless; against stage-gear high-power defense or accuracy-built decks it struggles. Peach doesn't always go forward; if Vampire dies early it collapses.

sources.title: 와레나는 방어 성공해도
sources.summaryEn: The defense-success image shows the regular Arena currency, but players say you actually receive Rumble medals. 74134 and 73880 mention the same early bug.

sources.title: 뭐야 와레나 이건 뭐냐?
sources.summaryEn: In the defense log, attackers above 2,000 pts show as '익명의 도전자' (anonymous challenger), with power '????' and levels 'Lv.??'. The lineup and pets are still visible. A defense success gives +1 and a loss −1. The revenge (복수) reward showed about 40–49 points.

sources.title: 렙업 수정한거 진짜 개병신같네
sources.summaryEn: The poster levels cookies to 30, 40, 50, 60, 65 and 70 in steps to get Milk to follow; replies: tap the number to type the level directly, and level down by resetting to 1.

sources.title: 아레나/토벌전 장비 추천
sources.summaryEn: Author compares two necklaces for arena/raid: equipped Eternal one with 치확 + 스가 (higher power) vs Legendary one with 스증 + 스가 (17.46M less power). Reply: memorize '스가스증' — skill amp wins despite lower power.

sources.title: [일반] 님들 치저가 피감보다 전투력 더 높음??
sources.titleEn: Crit resistance shows more power than DR?
sources.summaryEn: Crit resistance inflates displayed power the most and is the first pick for a stage preset.

sources.title: 와레나 덱 아레나에서 싸보니까 만년 2등이엿던 내가
sources.titleEn: Took the Rumble deck to regular Arena
sources.summaryEn: A perennial #2 in regular Arena copied a Rumble top-ranked deck (they all use Bari) and started crushing his server's #1.

sources.title: 이게 아레나 고점덱인가봄?
sources.titleEn: Is this the high-end arena deck?
sources.summaryEn: Lists the lineup that the whole Rumble top tier ran on day 1: Macaron, Oven Wanderer, Pinot, Cheesecake, Pomegranate, Bari, Milk, Hound, Ion, Cherry Cola, Herb, Moon Rabbit. Commenters frame it as the Charge cookies' revolt, enabled by the Rumble buff.

sources.title: 이거 버그아님?
sources.summaryEn: A 12.92M Rye deck holds well against Bari–Oven–Cherry Cola in Rumble (wins at +2 to +6M, once at 20M). The same deck in the poster's own server's regular Arena loses to the same archetype 3M lower, dying within 0.5 s. The poster suspects the Rumble 30% DR buff is the difference.

sources.title: 크럼블던전 40마리 우선출격 표기 사라진거같네
sources.summaryEn: After the 9/23 update the in-game label about 40 cookies deploying first disappeared.

sources.title: 아 시발 브시커 슈가룬 시발
sources.summaryEn: Bright Seeker rune with 7 SSR 스가 lines (4/5/5/4/4/4/5 = +31) and the last C line (회피율 1.20%) still being rolled — author says ~300k crystals went into the last line alone. Debate: one says 스가 only needs a threshold (40–45) and the rest should be 스증; author pulls 스증/치확/치피 from gear and 스가 from the rune; reply that uptime differences make up to 50 worthwhile (6 drones).

sources.title: 와레나 오바리덱 말안되는데..?
sources.summaryEn: The Oven–Bari deck is absurd; a reply attributes it to the Charge buff.

sources.title: 아레나 오방덱 좋긴하다
sources.titleEn: The Arena Oven deck is good
sources.summaryEn: 6.14M Bari–Oven deck with Bari 1★ beats older decks at up to double power. Formation top: Macaron, Pinot Noir, Pomegranate, Milk, Ion, Herb; bottom: Oven Wanderer, Cheesecake, Bari, Hound, Cherry Cola, Moon Rabbit. Pets Holy Baby Drop 20, Hot Doggie 17, Icy Birdie 18. Oven runes Skill AMP, ATK%, DR for now.

sources.title: 와레나 덱에서 바리 없으면
sources.summaryEn: A no-Bari Rumble lineup from a regular: Macaron, Doughnut King, Pinot, Pomegranate, Milk, Ion, Rye, Melon Soda, Cheesecake, Espresso, Hound, Moon Rabbit, with pets Holy Baby Drop, Hot Doggie and Chargemellow.

sources.title: 토벌에서 치저 필요 없으면 방어력 장비 고르는게 나음?
sources.titleEn: If crit res isn't needed in raid, should I pick DEF gear?
sources.summaryEn: Author building raid set wants to swap 피감+치저 gear for 피감+방어력. Only reply: 'all mine are 피감+체력'.

sources.title: 아레나 치저보다 피감이 좋음?
sources.titleEn: DR better than crit RES in Arena?
sources.summaryEn: In-battle Milk stat panels: poster's Milk crit RES 83.55% / DR 24.68% / Skill AMP 140% / Skill Haste 22; opponent's Milk (whom he keeps losing to) crit RES 60.83% / DR 38.37% / Skill AMP 145.5% / Skill Haste 20.4 / crit DMG 84.7%. Reply: DR.

sources.title: 전섭 아레나 아까 낮부터 스테 안 밀고 덱 연구했다!!!
sources.titleEn: Spent the day researching cross-server arena decks
sources.summaryEn: ㄹㄹ노아 (곰인형) spent the day testing decks, with Bari 6★ and Moon Rabbit 7★. The screenshot shows a loss at 25.35M against 27.54M: −5 points (2,614), rank unchanged at 3rd.

sources.title: 토벌덱 저번주에 800M 이었는데
sources.titleEn: My raid deck was 800M last week
sources.summaryEn: Author's raid score went from 800M last week to 1.6G. Image is a reaction GIF (chibi red-haired girl), no data.

sources.title: 와레나 마스터 찍먹
sources.summaryEn: Main screen on 09-24 03:14: 1 凱凱の餅乾軍團 3,156, 2 적신 3,087, 3 ㄹㄹ노아 3,060. The poster is at 2,009, rank 477, Master 5 (top 95.40%). Promotion needs 2,000 and top 80% for 1,500 gems. Defense 14.19M, attack 14.61M.

sources.title: 오방 슈가룬 어케줌?
sources.summaryEn: Asked for Oven Wanderer runes in Rumble, the one reply says defensive lines are the right call.

sources.title: [일반] 팀투 4g 가려면 머 어케해야대노
sources.summaryEn: Answers for 4G: Stellar 8 plus all plates 20 gives about 3G (one reply), Stellar 9 and all 25 (another); a correction: Stellar 8-6 or more, a weapon at 20 and all others at 15 already clears 4G; a server whale has everything but Tea Knight at 10★.

sources.title: 와글레나 순위 예상외네
sources.summaryEn: The top ranks mix players from early and late servers; the early servers didn't take over as expected. 75612 says the same.

sources.title: 와레나 바리 성급 낮아도 걍 써야되네
sources.titleEn: Use Bari in Rumble even at low stars
sources.summaryEn: A 2★ Bari deck won with Bari doing 2.03M damage, beating a Wind Archer / Brightseeker / Cooling Mint deck. The poster posted the full lineup: Macaron, Pinot, Pomegranate, Milk, Ion, Herb, Oven, Cheesecake, Bari, Hound, Cherry Cola, Moon Rabbit, with pets Icy Birdie (no Majestic King Choco Drop), Hot Doggie and Holy Baby Drop. Commenters disagree on whether Rye decks still beat it.

sources.title: [일반] 돌파력 1000단계 찍은애들있냐?
sources.summaryEn: Resolve 800 and 944 reported on 2026-09-24; the latter expects the high 900s after spending banked coins.

sources.title: 아레나 돌격덱으로 바꾸고 연승함
sources.titleEn: Switched Arena to the charge deck and won streaks
sources.summaryEn: The same player (물참피) moved the Rumble charge deck into regular Arena and started winning. The attack-team card shows 13.88M, 1,871 pts, all Lv.100, pets Icy Birdie 19, Hot Doggie 20, Holy Baby Drop 20. Oven runes are 피감 치피 because the poster hasn't optimised them yet.

sources.title: 걍 무과금들은 이 덱 써라
sources.titleEn: F2P players, just use this deck
sources.summaryEn: The reference 'Rye one-carry' (호밀 원툴) deck that the gallery's 정보 tab links and everyone later calls 정보탭 호밀덱. Preset named 아레나/토벌, 13.87M power. Poster says it defends very well; perks 피감 (Armor Repair) + 열정페이. The defense-log screenshot is from Rumble Arena (S-server tags, +125 medals).

sources.title: [일반] 한달마다 TSSR나오고 과금해야한다니 빡세다
sources.titleEn: A new TSSR every month is expensive
sources.summaryEn: A monthly TSSR at 5★ costs 200,000–300,000 KRW; 100,000 KRW got one player 3★.

sources.title: 보상 수준
sources.summaryEn: Three Rumble boxes gave 5 pet tickets and some dough, which the poster calls meagre.

sources.title: 비리5성단들 와레나 석류빨대 비리가 받게함?
sources.titleEn: 5★ Bari users: do you route Pomegranate onto Bari?
sources.summaryEn: To make Bari rather than Cherry Cola receive Pomegranate's buff, you'd strip Cherry Cola's ATK and stack Bari's. The reply: at 5★ you have to give up on the buff.

sources.title: 회피셋 좋네
sources.summaryEn: With an evasion set (1,005 evasion vs the enemy's 950 accuracy), an 8.41M Rye + Vampire deck beat a 16.53M opponent easily; commenters credit Vampire. It won all 5 revenge fights. The poster runs 스증 스가 피감 회피 and prefers DMG reduction over crit resistance because of Moon Rabbit.

sources.title: 각 프리셋당 옵션 정리글 있음?
sources.titleEn: Is there a summary of options per preset?
sources.summaryEn: Author wants three presets (arena, stage, raid). One commenter: arena = 명중 + 집중; raid = 공격 + 회피. (This conflicts with other posts, where 명중/집중 is the stage set.)

sources.title: 소과금은 와레나 이 덱이 베스트 인듯?
sources.titleEn: For light spenders this is the best Rumble deck?
sources.summaryEn: 러너 (a known top player) copies a gallery Rye deck; his 18.77M version won against a 27M Oven/Bari/Brightseeker deck with Rye doing 2.29M. He calls it the best deck without Brightseeker or Bari, with high attack and defense win rates. The formation screen shows the levels, the 'arena/Conquest' preset and the pets.

sources.title: 정보탭 호밀덱 ㄹㅇ좋네
sources.titleEn: The info-tab Rye deck is really good
sources.summaryEn: Result screen: Rye 2.26M damage, Seeker 324K, Moon Rabbit 262K; the opponent Rye/Grapevine deck's Rye did only 172K. Comments: give Rye ATK runes so it gets Pomegranate's opening beam; poster gives some ATK so Rye comes after Milk and Seeker in ATK order; SR runes suffice. Cheesecake can be swapped for Crepe.

sources.title: 토벌펫 여전히 판다지??
sources.titleEn: Raid pet is still Panda, right?
sources.summaryEn: Four replies unanimously say to use the new pet instead of Panda; it's a strict upgrade and Panda is 'retired'.

sources.title: 체리덱 528배
sources.summaryEn: Same author (저장용): 528x with the 71135 cherry deck after finishing sugar runes and spec-ups.

sources.title: 시커 5성 1t단 입갤
sources.summaryEn: Melon Soda deck (메소/전갈/브시커) reaching ~1T at 1.6G team power (~625x per commenter) with only a 5★ Bright Seeker. Key tech: move-speed (이동속도) sugar-rune lines locked on Pinot Noir, Melon Soda and Seeker to force a formation/ordering that works; he gets correct ordering ~3 of 4 runs, fails by 0.03 speed differences. Jungle Warrior runes are all skill-haste.

sources.title: 토벌 체리덱에서
sources.summaryEn: Q: why exactly is Cherry in the Cherry deck (some use Melon Soda)? Answers: it's one way to make Seeker receive Macaron's buff well; each cookie included slightly changes starting placement, and Cherry is there to make the formation a straight line. Other says deck choice makes little difference as long as Seeker is buffed.

sources.title: 17초 슬슬 버티네
sources.summaryEn: The author will take the HP +30% research. Reply: only Milk and Seeker survive, so it isn't worth it yet.

sources.title: 호밀이 좋긴좋네
sources.summaryEn: Removing Wind Archer and Seeker for a Rye single carry gives a much better win rate.

sources.title: [일반] 18초에 애들 죽는데 렙업 시켜야함?
sources.titleEn: Cookies start dying at 18s, should I level them?
sources.summaryEn: Reports that the wipe isn't an instant simultaneous kill exactly at 17s: cookies start getting picked off individually from ~19s remaining, with the last ones going down at the 17s mark. Screenshot (transcribed) shows a mid-fight frame: damage counter 112,876,676,987, a small '18.767' readout near the boss, several dead-cookie portraits (greyed with an hourglass badge) still shown in the bottom bar alongside living ones — dead cookies remain visible in the UI with a distinct 'downed' icon rather than disappearing.

sources.title: 바리공주 오방 체콜덱 개재밌네..
sources.titleEn: The Bari–Oven–Cherry Cola deck is fun
sources.summaryEn: Three win screens with a Bari (3★ visible)–Oven–Cherry Cola deck (Ion Lv.90). It beat a Rye/Pinot/Hound/Skating Queen deck, a Brightseeker/Wind Archer/Milky Way/Crepe deck and a mirror Bari/Brightseeker/Oven deck. Bari, Oven and Cherry Cola top the damage each time (1.1–2.1M each). The poster says it also beats non-charge decks 3M stronger.

sources.title: 토벌 ㄹㅇ 왜케 안나옴
sources.titleEn: Why is my raid score so low
sources.summaryEn: Cherry-deck screenshot: 72G 82M at 752.83M team power (~96배), 4th personal rank; same 12-cookie layout as 75400 but the Lv.45/90 slot is Lv.1 and one Lv.100 slot is Lv.80. Advice: retry count is the issue; replace 정전 with 허브 if someone dies at 30s; level the others to ~3.5M HP while keeping ATK order. Author says they do survive 30s and use 스증스가 raid gear.

sources.title: 17초 이후 버티는 사람있음?
sources.summaryEn: One reply gives the minimum condition for surviving the 17 s wipe as 9M HP and 45% damage reduction. Another says it is possible but not a damage gain yet.

sources.title: [일반] 석류 씨발련아
sources.summaryEn: OP complains Pomegranate (a pure buffer who should stay at the back) keeps charging forward and wrecking the formation; a commenter's fix is to strip all move-speed stats and rebuild as a full Cherry-deck.

sources.title: 뉴비 토벌전 17배 나오는데 이정도면 어떤수준임?
sources.titleEn: Newbie getting 17x in raid — what level is that?
sources.summaryEn: Newbie at 22M power scores ~380M (~17배) copying the raid deck with 전갈/피노/정글 at Lv.1; Seeker 6★, cannot survive to 17s. Replies: 15x+ is good at that power; surviving to 17s and Seeker 5★+ matter; survival comes from gear and 돌파력 research raising DEF/HP/DR.

sources.title: [일반] 명중 거르고 투력 올렸더니 드디어 G단위갔다
sources.titleEn: Skipped accuracy for power and reached 1G
sources.summaryEn: Choosing raw-power gear over accuracy after the easing took the poster over 1G; stages became easy enough that one accuracy line auto-clears GingerCraven.

sources.title: 17초 이후에 피겨랑 2마리 더 사는데
sources.titleEn: 피겨 and two more survive past 17 s
sources.summaryEn: At ~2.7G (levels excluded) 피겨 + 2 others survive past 17 s; asks how to reach 1T with cherry deck. Reply: infinite retries.

sources.title: 체리덱 580배
sources.summaryEn: 981G 118M at 1.69G (580x) with the 71135 cherry setup, just more sugar-rune polish and spec-ups. Seeker runes changed from all-haste to mostly haste plus a little skill amp/crit dmg. ~1 in 5 manual runs hits 500x; author estimates the true ceiling ≈ your ~20-run best + 10–20%.

sources.title: 이속 기록
sources.summaryEn: Candy Apple's repost of the Melon-deck move-speed runes. Jungle Warrior: SSR haste +5, SR +2, SR +3 locked. Pinot: locked move speed C +0.26, R +0.57 (plus unlocked U +0.32). Melon Soda: locked R +0.51, C +0.20. Bright Seeker (5★, only 3 rune slots unlocked): SSR haste +5, SSR haste +4, U move speed +0.32. Perks still 열정페이 + 초고속승진. When Pomegranate breaks the line, just retry. A commenter infers final speeds Pinot 4.65 / Melon 4.71 / Seeker 3.82 (unconfirmed).

sources.title: 토벌 기갱 263g
sources.summaryEn: Cherry-deck layout, 263G 471M personal (rank 1 in guild) at 1.19G team power (~221배), up from 190G. ATK order given: 우 브 피 실 마 치 전. Commenters: with retries 500G+; someone with Seeker 7★ and 900M power got 350G after ~100 runs; another says that spec can reach 700G; 'up to 400 is reachable, beyond that only if you grind like a log'.

sources.summaryEn: The info-tab Rye deck can't beat Bari + Cherry Cola. Replies: Grapevine instead of Seeker is stronger; in regular Arena few use Bari so it's fine.

sources.title: 와글레나 돌격버프 없이 나왔으면

sources.summaryEn: Without the Charge buff, a commenter says Rye would kill everything. Another says Rye can't be countered by a Charles deck or 색동 (Candy Shade Pouch).

sources.title: 브시커 슈가룬 어케해야댈지 고민중

sources.summaryEn: Pre-10★ Bright Seeker rune with 6 active lines (3 스가, 1 스증, 2 치피) and 2 lines locked until ★10. Author considers rerolling both 치피 into 스가. Replies: all-스가 is the standard ('국룰'); skill stacks; one dissent '10성기준 스가4 스증6 정배'.

sources.title: [일반] 스테 장비 집중 투력 왜이리 많이 쳐줘?
sources.titleEn: Why does focus count so much for power?
sources.summaryEn: With 1,100 accuracy and 1,200 focus, swapping an accuracy line for focus still adds 7M power.

sources.titleEn: What comp if I can't survive the 30-second slam?
sources.summaryEn: Author fears the Lv.1 strategy won't work without surviving the 30s slam. Reply: just use the 정전 Cherry deck anyway — commenter's alt at 200M power got 6G even with everyone dying at the 30s slam, with 전갈 and 피노 both Lv.1. Another: drop 정전, add 허브.

sources.title: 아레나 호밀덱 카운터 뭐임?
sources.titleEn: What counters the Arena Rye deck?
sources.summaryEn: Poster loses to Rye even with Bari and Moon Rabbit. Answers: a stronger Rye; a deck with Cherry Cola, Bari and Oven wins when it deletes Rye in one go.

sources.title: 와레나 1등 보아라 !!!!
sources.summaryEn: A world-arena match screen with the names blurred; the poster is 3rd at 25.35M. A commenter unmasks the players as 'ㄹㄹ노아' and 타미 (Carpediem, conquest #4). The strongest opponent is about 30M. Arena only.

sources.title: 어제오늘 쌔빠지게 뚫어서 이면 도착햇는데
sources.titleEn: Grinded through to the Other Side (이면)
sources.summaryEn: The 차원의 이면 dungeon's bonus stats apply only inside that dungeon, not to raid; its pet gives 50% 이면-boss damage. Image: 차원의 힘 level effects (ATK/DEF/HP +10%, crit dmg +30%, crit rate +10%, focus +5%, accuracy +10%, all '차원의 이면' only). Author cleared at ~4.2G team power.

sources.title: 아레나 바리덱 유행하는데 카운터없음?
sources.titleEn: Bari deck is trending; any counter?
sources.summaryEn: Answers: Rye one-carry deck. One suggests a Rapid Fire deck with Donut King and Adventurer so Oven can't do anything. One says Bari decks are oddly weak to 3-tank Rye.

sources.title: 장비 프리셋생기고 너무 어려운데 내 판단 맞는지 조언 부탁해!
sources.titleEn: Gear presets are confusing — is my plan right?
sources.summaryEn: Author plans stage/arena/raid presets: stage = 명중/집중 line, arena = 스가/스증/피감, raid = 회피/스증/피감. Replies: 전투력 only matters for stage; one commenter isn't sure a raid preset is needed at all and gives a per-slot arena layout (top-left 스증+치확, bottom-left 피감+치저, top-right 스증+스가, bottom-right 스가 + 치저/피감) and stage accuracy/focus ~1000/1100.

sources.title: 와레나 바리 필수급임?
sources.summaryEn: Reply: you need about Oven 7★ and Bari 5★ to hold your own in Arena, and without Bari you skip Oven too.

sources.title: 토벌전 장비 프리셋 치확vs치피
sources.titleEn: Raid gear preset: crit rate vs crit damage
sources.summaryEn: Author: top-right 스가+스증; top-left is it 스증+치확 (arena) and 스증+치피 (raid)? Replies: just take higher 스증; another says the opposite — raid doesn't use 치피, only 치확, with 스증 main; a third notes 치피 is bad in arena due to 치저.

sources.title: 메소정전 토벌덱 전갈이 영원히 마카롱을 못받으면

sources.summaryEn: Question: in the 메소+정전 raid deck, if Scorpion never gets Macaron's buff, should you tune 메소/피노 move speed? No replies.

sources.title: [일반] 근데 이면 실질적 투력 스펙업 없으면 좆같은데
sources.titleEn: The Rift gives no real power
sources.summaryEn: The Rift's rewards give no lasting power growth; sugar runes are the scarce material (38,000 Rune Crystals from the Rift feel small when good lines take hundreds of thousands).

sources.titleEn: Seeing Bari, Bright Seeker was just 'dealer #1'
sources.summaryEn: Opinion that Princess Bari is even more broken than Bright Seeker, except in Crumble/raid where control issues make her troll. Commenter calls her 오방's 'wheelchair' (enables 오방).

sources.title: 바리 없으면 꼬운 수준임? 필수야?
sources.summaryEn: Mixed views. One side: Bari is broken in Arena too, 5★ is enough and 10★ is for arena bullies, and she must receive Pomegranate's buff. The other side: not mandatory like Brightseeker, and she'll be benched once the Rumble Charge buff goes.

sources.title: 와 근데 와레나 버프 2개였네
sources.summaryEn: Confirms the two buffs: Charge HP +30% and 30% DMG reduction for all cookies.

sources.title: 와레나 티켓 원래 5장임??
sources.summaryEn: The challenge button shows 5/8 tickets. A reply says the real maximum is 5 and the 8 is the bug.

sources.title: 아레나 포도 대신에 락스타도 ㄱㅊ한거같은데?

sources.summaryEn: Tests the Rye deck with Rockstar in the Grapevine slot. Rockstar's recent skill-ready (스킬준비) buff makes its shield land during Bari's first dive. Screenshots: Rumble attack at 13.27M vs 16.72M Bari–Oven, and three regular Arena (시즌5 아레나) fights, including a win at 13.27M against the server's #2 (20.4M) running Brightseeker/Oven/Bari/Cherry Cola, where Rye did 2.21M damage. Long thread on why Regular Arena Bari burst is harder to survive than Rumble.

sources.title: 걍 뭔가 와레나 점수 올리기가 쉬운데?
sources.summaryEn: Keep three attack presets and pick by matchup: the Rye deck beats Bari decks, the Crepe–Espresso deck beats Rye decks, and the Bari deck beats Crepe–Espresso decks. The Crepe–Espresso deck is the old '5-Ranged perk' deck: Crepe, Espresso, Rye, Pure Vanilla (바궁), Milky Way, Milk, Pomegranate, Macaron, Pinot, Doughnut King, Hound, Ion.

sources.title: 와레나 한정보상도 없는데 열심히 하는 사람 있음?
sources.titleEn: Anyone grinding Rumble with no limited reward? (me)
sources.summaryEn: Posted by ㄹㄹ노아 (crumb.gg rank 3 on 09-27), who was then overall #1 (3,406 pts, Champion 1, attack and defense power 27.91M). He says it's pure PvP with no guild effects, so anyone can place. Asked for the Bari and Ion runes, he answered 피감 체력 스증 스가.

sources.title: 1T 클럽 가입 완료
sources.summaryEn: Screenshot: 1T 66G personal best at 2.38G team power (~448x), cherry-deck roster WITHOUT the new pet (핫도그 20, 와사비문어 20, 판다 19). Scorpion at Lv60 — commenter warns this may mess up ATK order.

sources.title: 아레나 팔꺼면 마카롱 공퍼 슈가룬이 맞긴 한 듯
sources.titleEn: If you're serious about arena, ATK% runes on Macaron
sources.summaryEn: Explains ATK-order routing in a Rye deck: Macaron, Rye, Brightseeker (or Milky Way), Doughnut King, Pinot, Cheesecake, Pomegranate, Milk, Ion, Herb, Hound. The top three by ATK must be Milk > Rye ≥ Pomegranate so Pomegranate's buff lands on Rye. Hound should out-ATK Milky Way so Macaron's crit buff routes correctly and everything funnels to Rye. A variant against Bari drops Wind Archer and Brightseeker for Moon Rabbit and Grapevine. A commenter's Bari deck deleted this old ranker deck in about 1 s in Rumble.

sources.title: 보급형 회슝좍 방어확률 꽤괜인듯
sources.titleEn: Budget evasion deck defends quite well
sources.summaryEn: 6.8M budget evasion defense on a small server, with a 10M defense success. Lineup: Macaron, Donut, Pomegranate, Milk, Ion, Herb, Rye, Pinot Noir, Vampire, Hound, Crepe, Moon Rabbit (the image shows Moon Rabbit). Pets Hot Doggie, Icy Birdie, Cheese Drop. Wishlist with 5★ Bari: Macaron, Bari, Vampire, Cherry Cola, Peach, Pomegranate, Milk, Ion, Herb, Pinot, Crepe, Moon Rabbit.

The poster's defense is 12 Lv.100 cookies (Macaron, Oven Wanderer, Pinot, Cheesecake, Pomegranate, Bari, Milk, Hound, Ion, Cherry Cola, Herb, Moon Rabbit) with pets Hot Doggie 18, Holy Baby Drop 19, Majestic King Choco Drop 20. He sits at 1,815 pts, rank 2,257.

sources.title: 아레나장비 스증도 중요하구나
sources.titleEn: Skill AMP matters on Arena gear
sources.summaryEn: Poster won 10 of 10 against someone, dropped two Skill AMP lines for power, and immediately lost. Reply: Skill AMP is the top stat in this game because it also scales buffs.

sources.title: 토벌 메소덱 맞춰봤는데
sources.titleEn: Tried the raid Melon Soda deck
sources.summaryEn: Author matched move speeds and alignment (정렬) per a guide for the Melon Soda deck, but even an overnight macro retry never produced a 'world line' run; stuck at ~400배. Manual retries showed late Macaron alignment failing; alignment is much harder to get than in the Cherry deck. Another says alignment worked last week but not this week, possibly because of Seeker's 스가 timing.

sources.title: 크럼블던전 왜 체력바가 뜨냐?

sources.summaryEn: Screenshot of the Holy Golden Drop fight overlaid with a stage boss's HP bar (a display bug); it also shows 76 cookies in play at 1G 641M.

sources.title: 와레나 방덱 열어두는 애들은 뭐냐

sources.summaryEn: Tickets have to be bought with mileage, unlike regular Arena. Keeping a real defense to hold points beats becoming a free target.

sources.summaryEn: In regular Arena, a 5★ Bari deck deletes Brightseeker ranged decks 3–4M stronger on contact.

sources.title: [일반] 약간 후회중인 거
sources.summaryEn: One player bought three 79,000 KRW Stellar packs chasing 100% and ended at 92%; 'Stellar isn't for buying unless you're top-end'.

sources.titleEn: Why do some put only one cookie on defense?
sources.summaryEn: Some players leave a 1-cookie defense so they drop in points. That gets them easier opponents and revenge targets, and saves refreshing. 75232 and 75307 describe the same tanking.

sources.title: [일반] 스테 35퍼로 밀거면 명중 1200까진 해주는게맞음?
sources.titleEn: For 35% stages, should accuracy go to 1200?

sources.title: 님들아 와레나 랭커들 다 아레나셋이 아니라 스테셋쓰는거 같던데 이유기뭐임
sources.titleEn: Why do Rumble rankers use stage sets, not arena sets?
sources.summaryEn: Observation that Rumble rankers appear to use their stage (accuracy) gear preset. 76490 says the same; a reply suggests it's to counter evasion decks.

sources.title: 체리덱 641배 찍었음
sources.summaryEn: Cherry deck: 1T 116G at 1.74G team power (641배), guild rank 1. ATK order 우유 브시 피겨 카롱 실론 치케 전갈; 4 Lv.1 cookies (체리 닼초 피노 정전) and 전갈 raised to Lv.45 deliberately so Pomegranate's straw goes to Scorpion rather than Dark Choco when Ceylon misses Milk's buff. Pets 와사비문어/핫도그/색동주머니 all ★20. Gear: 스가 6 + 스증 6, rest crit/crit dmg, spare slots DR; no move speed anywhere; team wipes at 17s; ~1T once or twice per 10 runs, occasionally 1.1T.

sources.title: 회피 해골물 맞음?
sources.summaryEn: The poster runs the Bari–Oven charge deck (돌장연) with evasion gear, about 1,350 evasion in battle at 15.5M. He takes no damage at equal power and beats +2–3M. Replies: accuracy of about 1,000–1,050 is typical (bow at +15–21), top players use +20 bows, and many carry one accuracy line. Evasion is better on attack presets than on defense.

sources.title: 토벌 시커 7성인데 슈가룬 올 스가 주는게 맞냐?

sources.summaryEn: Question from 340 (Seeker 7★) whether to go all-스가 on the rune; single reply 'go' (ㄱㄱ).

sources.title: 기갱했다요
sources.summaryEn: Result screen 1,617,831,110,058 (1.62T), '~600x of power' (→ ~2.7G), guild rank 1 with 14T 849G guild total. Seeker 10★, only 4 haste lines on Seeker, 색동주머니 pet, no move speed.

sources.title: 근데 바리덱 같은 체급 호밀덱한테 그냥 개썰리던데
sources.titleEn: Bari decks get shredded by same-power Rye decks
sources.summaryEn: Poster wiped all the 5★ Bari decks on his server with Rye. One reply says they have never lost to the same weight class after switching to Bari. Another notes regular Arena has no charger buff (Rumble does).

sources.title: 근데 호밀덱이 바리덱 잡는단건 어디서 나온 말임
sources.titleEn: Where did 'Rye beats Bari' come from?
sources.summaryEn: Poster's defense logs (Rumble: S-server tags, +125 medals) show his Bari–Oven–Cherry Cola deck holding against several Rye decks of similar or higher power. Replies: the Oven's fire at the start ends it; others say it's settings, and they have seen Rye beat 7★ Bari.

sources.title: 와레나에선 당연히 접대받는데 바리덱이 쎄지
sources.titleEn: Of course Bari is strong in Rumble, it's pampered
sources.summaryEn: Bari decks are strong in Rumble because of the Charge buff, but not to the same degree in regular Arena, where Rye decks have the matchup edge unless spec is overwhelming.

sources.title: 토벌 장비 골라주라 치확 치피때문에 고민임..
sources.titleEn: Pick my raid gear — torn on crit rate vs crit dmg
sources.summaryEn: Weapon comparison for raid: Lv95 wand with 스증 7.52% + 치피 13.63% vs Lv100 wand with 치확 16.39% + 스증 9.13%. Single reply: definitely right one (higher 스증, 치확).

sources.title: 갠적으로 이덱이 스테 오토 제일 괜찮은듯
sources.titleEn: Personally this deck is the best for stage auto
sources.summaryEn: Stage (not raid) auto deck share. Pinot Noir kept low level deliberately so it does not take Pomegranate's buff; starting buff recipients 호밀/우유/딸크. Perks: armor special + 열정페이. Not raid-specific.

sources.title: 내 장비 프리셋 목록
sources.summaryEn: Preset names (image): '35%(명중집중)' for stage, '아레나(전투+치감)', '토벌전(스가세팅)', '쓰레기통' (dump for auto-sell by power), and a joke empty slot. Commenter afrehh runs 5: 스테(뻥툴), 토벌, 아레나1(정석), 아레나2(회피), 아레나3(명중) because arena is rock-paper-scissors.

sources.title: 바리덱 단순히 체퍼30때문에 쌘건 아닌데
sources.titleEn: The Bari deck isn't strong just because of 30% HP
sources.summaryEn: Cherry Cola, Oven and Bari dive together and delete an equal-power team in about 3.5 seconds, around 2M damage each. One side says a defensive deck that survives one tick wins; another says Ion and Rockstar shields after their skill-ready buff sometimes stop the instant kill, making it a luck contest of Ion/Rockstar/Donut procs. One user says at similar spec the Rye one-carry deck crushes it.

sources.title: [✋️질문] 토벌 투력 몇쯤돼야 30초에 안뒤짐?
sources.titleEn: What power is needed to not die at 30s?
sources.summaryEn: Gives a rough power-to-30s-survival curve from two independent commenters: ~400M power survives with 1-2 cookies, ~600M survives with the whole team, ~1.5G power comfortably never dies at 30s.

sources.title: 근데 와레나도 바리덱이 호밀한테 개털리는거 맞음?
sources.titleEn: Do Bari decks really get wrecked by Rye in Rumble too?
sources.summaryEn: The gallery says Rye + Ion + Rockstar wrecks Bari, yet no top Rumble player (SR all 10★) uses a Rye defense. Consensus in the replies: Rye is stronger at mid-to-upper spec, but Bari decks win at whale top-end. Against max-spec Bari, the buffed divers ('빨대 맞고 쳐들어오는 근숭이') kill everything on contact. At mid spec, Grapevine healing gets a window and Rye turns the fight.

sources.title: 아레나 치확치피 vs 치피스증
sources.titleEn: Crit rate+DMG vs crit DMG+Skill AMP
sources.summaryEn: Nothing beats Skill AMP; crit rate+Skill AMP best; in Arena think about Moon Rabbit (crit rate reduction), so crit rate for Arena and crit DMG for Conquest.

sources.title: 토벌 치확이 필요함?
sources.titleEn: Is crit rate needed in raid?
sources.summaryEn: Author: boss has no crit res so is crit rate needed? Answers: crit rate above 100% keeps adding — every 100% of crit rate adds another crit-damage instance (200% = crits twice; 198% = one crit plus 98% chance of a second). So crit rate is 'more is better'; one says always double crit rate (치확 둘둘). Unresolved whether 치확 or 치피 is better when forced to choose.

sources.title: 아레나 이덱 줘패고싶은데 방법좀 아시는분(제발)
sources.titleEn: How do I beat this Arena deck?
sources.summaryEn: Screenshot of a Bari–Oven–Cherry Cola defense that keeps beating the poster at equal power; its pets are Holy Baby Drop, Hot Doggie, King Choco Drop, all max. The key difference spotted: the opponent's Milk captain is merc level 4, unlocking Armor Repair (DR 10%) and Passion Pay. Advice: Rye + Rockstar in theory; if still marginal, swap Choco Drop for Icy Birdie.

sources.title: [✋️질문] 바리 스테 구리다는거 바없찐들 연막이냐?
sources.titleEn: Is 'Bari is bad in stages' a smokescreen by people without Bari?

sources.title: 토벌 장비추천좀
sources.summaryEn: 340 set weapons all to 스증+치피 and compares Lv98 wand (스증 7.47% + 치피 14.53%) vs Lv103 wand (치확 16.51% + 스증 8.00%). Replies favour the latter: 1.4 crit rate ≈ 1 crit dmg in value, but higher 스증 always wins; aim for +15 pieces with 치확/치피 20%+ and 스증 9%+. 340 notes their arena set (치확) scored lower in raid than the raid set (치피).

sources.title: 토벌 1T 넣는사람 팀투 몇임??
sources.titleEn: What team power do 1T raiders have?
sources.summaryEn: People scoring 1T in raid have ~2G team power per one comment; 저장용 (the 641배 author) is at 1.77G with the full level list: 우유 브시 피겨 카롱 실론 치케 석류 at Lv.100, 전갈 Lv.10, 체리 닼초 피노 정전 Lv.1; pets 와사비문어 핫도그 색동주머니.

sources.title: 바리 슈가룬 뭐줌?
sources.summaryEn: Advice: Skill Haste + DR; about 45 skill haste keeps the aura up permanently. Skill AMP doesn't raise the DR buff but may raise aura damage; alternatively ATK so Bari catches Pomegranate's beam.

sources.title: [일반] 바리 스테덱 국룰 나왓음?
sources.titleEn: Is there a standard Bari stage deck yet?

sources.title: 크럼블던전 존나 이상하네
sources.summaryEn: At 4.2G total power the poster's best is 45G but runs now land at 25G plus or minus 2G; reply: Milk must have arrived early that time.

sources.title: 아레나 프리셋이 더 잘미네 ㅋㅋㅋㅋ
sources.titleEn: The Arena preset clears stages better
sources.summaryEn: At stage 290 the arena preset (1G 900M, Skill AMP/Skill Haste) clears better than the stage preset (2G 100M, accuracy/focus). Many agree 6 Skill Haste beats accuracy/focus at the 35% power cut.

sources.title: 아레나 유행 반영 빠르네 ㅋㅋㅋ
sources.summaryEn: After the poster hit people with the Rye one-carry deck, they copied it within a meal. Reply lays out a rock-paper-scissors: counter Rye with Crepe + Espresso (Crepe counters Moon Rabbit's 떡방아 by knocking back, Espresso's black hole launches Rye from behind); if they copy Crepe–Espresso, counter with Bari. Another server's top ranks run Bari–Oven–Cherry Cola.

sources.title: [일반] 노쇳물 12강 할만함?
sources.summaryEn: Plating without Syrup Metal is fine to 12–13 (some say 15). A 1.6G player: one plate level adds about 8M, and 14→15 adds 20–30M, so a few levels add 30–40M.

sources.title: 토벌전 딜량 복사 진짜 있는거였구나
sources.titleEn: So the raid damage 'copy' is real
sources.summaryEn: The author, usually around 15×, once got ~80× and can't reproduce it. They call the lucky spike '점수 복사' (score copy) and say this is why people hunt for the right 'world-line'. A reply mentions running macros. It's RNG slang, not a shown exploit.

sources.title: 바리덱을 잡는 호밀덱을 잡는 카운터덱 있을까..?
sources.titleEn: A counter to the Rye deck that beats Bari?
sources.summaryEn: Answer: Crepe–Espresso beats the Rye deck but is weak to charge decks.

sources.title: 딸크에소가 호밀 잡는다고?
sources.summaryEn: Doubt: one Moon Rabbit ground-slam cripples Espresso. Answer: if Crepe pushes first, the debuff doesn't land; put Moon Rabbit in the Crepe–Espresso deck too, push in, avoid Milk being debuffed, and the buffs roll.

sources.title: 아레나 치케투입+피노누아 있는데 허브 계륵아님?
sources.titleEn: With Cheesecake and Pinot Noir, is Herb dead weight?
sources.summaryEn: Poster's 12.92M 'bullet-cut' deck (Macaron, Oven, Cheesecake, Bari, Hound, Cherry Cola, Brightseeker, Pinot, Pomegranate, Milk, Ion, Moon Rabbit; pets King Choco Drop 20, Hot Doggie 19, Holy Baby 19) asks about replacing Herb with a back-line ranged dealer. Replies: without Herb, Milk can't self-heal and dies alone; running Milk + Herb + Ion is what stops the one-shot.

sources.title: 아니 그래서 딸크에소덱이 뭔데
sources.titleEn: So what is the Crepe–Espresso deck?
sources.summaryEn: Only a guessed lineup: Milk, Pomegranate, Macaron, Crepe, Espresso, Moon Rabbit, Ion, Donut, Herb, Hound, then Rye and Cheesecake.

sources.title: 토벌 딜 기준 슈가룬 우선순위 누구임?
sources.titleEn: For raid damage, whose sugar rune is top priority?
sources.summaryEn: Asks which SSR sugar-rune upgrade matters most for raid damage: Milk ATK line, Bright Seeker skill-haste line, or Pomegranate skill-amp line. Image is a 룬결정 던전 (stage 469) reward screen showing SSR 석류맛 쿠키 and SSR 전갈맛 쿠키 pulls. No answers.

sources.title: 동투력일때 호밀덱이 썰리면 문제있는거지?
sources.titleEn: If Rye loses at equal power, is something wrong?
sources.summaryEn: Poster runs the 74483 deck at 19-20M and gets sliced by Bari at equal power before heals and shields go off. Replies: Bari and Oven star levels matter; gear difference; the Rye deck needs 6 skill-haste lines; 'whoever loses Milk or Bari first loses'; with Seeker added Rye's position suffers.

sources.title: 딱히 없는 것 같아서 메모해놓는 스테/아레나/토벌 장비 옵션 (조언요)
sources.titleEn: Memo of stage/arena/raid gear substats (advice wanted)
sources.summaryEn: Author's tentative gear-substat memo per item group for stage, arena and raid (weapons 검/활/지팡이, armor 투구/갑옷/방패, accessories 목걸이/반지/브로치, objects 마법물체/책/음식). The one commenter gives a cleaner per-slot table: raid = top-left 스증치피, top-right 스가스증, bottom-left 피감체력, bottom-right 스가피감.

sources.title: 그래서 호밀덱 무슨버전이 제일 좋음?
sources.titleEn: So which Rye deck version is best?
sources.summaryEn: Lists the circulating Rye deck versions: Grapevine+Skating, Seeker+Donut, Donut+Rockstar. Three replies pick Seeker+Donut, one adds that below 5★ Seeker the Grapevine+Skating version is better.

sources.title: 아레나 들개자리에 감감쓰면됨?
sources.summaryEn: Hound gives Range synergy, which aligns Macaron's march; Milky Way ruins Macaron's alignment and must go. Standard tank trio: Hound, Ion, Moon Rabbit.

sources.title: 브시커 스킬가속 필수임?
sources.titleEn: Is skill haste mandatory on Bright Seeker?
sources.summaryEn: Author's Bright Seeker sugar rune has 4 unlocked lines (SR 스가 +3.00, SR 공증 4.70%, SSR 공증 6.50%, SSR 공증 6.10%) and thinks the ATK% lines must go for raid (to keep Seeker's ATK under Milk). Commenters: reroll everything and aim for at least two SSR 스가 lines; one notes that with only 4 slots even full SSR 스가 barely passes 40, so maybe 1 스가 + 3 스증.

sources.title: 아레나 명중안챙겨도 할만하네
sources.summaryEn: Poster removed the one accuracy line and barely sees MISS; enemy evasion is around 650.

sources.title: 와 토벌 프리셋 신세계네 진짜
sources.titleEn: Wow, a raid gear preset is a whole new world
sources.summaryEn: Author built a gear preset picking only 스증/스가/피감 and says raid score jumped. A long comment thread lays out a four-preset system: raid (스증치피, 스증스가, 피감체력, 스가피감), arena (스증치확, 스증스가, 피감치저, 스가피감), stage 55% 'raw power' preset and stage 35% 'solid power' preset with 명중/집중. Explains why crit dmg beats crit rate in raid: monsters have no crit resistance and buffs push crit rate very high.

sources.title: [일반] 스테 15% 뚫긴했는데
sources.titleEn: I did break through a stage at 15%

sources.title: 바리덱 뭘로 파훼해야되냐
sources.titleEn: How do I break the Bari deck?
sources.summaryEn: Poster wins under half against Bari with Rye. Replies: nothing in the Rye deck beats a 10★ Bari deck; the answer is not to attack it.

sources.title: 와레나 그마컷 늘려야하는거아니냐
sources.titleEn: Rumble grandmaster cut should be wider
sources.summaryEn: A screenshot of the Season 1 season-ranking rewards: 1st 3,200 pts 60,000 gems + 25,000 medals; 2nd 50,000 + 25,000; 3rd 45,000 + 25,000; ≤10th (3,000 pts) 40,000 + 25,000; ≤30th 35,000 + 25,000; ≤100th 30,000 + 25,000. Master League (2,000 pts): top 5% 25,000 + 20,000, top 10% 24,000 + 20,000, top 20% 23,000 + 15,000, top 30% 22,000 + 15,000. Rewards pay out automatically at season end. The screen also has 매일 랭킹 (daily ranking) and 한정 보상 (limited rewards) tabs.

sources.title: 아레나 펫 뭐써??
sources.summaryEn: Holy Baby Drop, King Choco Drop, Hot Doggie, Icy Birdie are the usual picks.

sources.title: 토벌기갱 439g
sources.summaryEn: 439G 790M at 1.53G team power (~287배) with the Cherry deck; ATK order 우 브 피 실 마 치 전. Took 35 tries. Seeker 스가 41.6 at 7★. Macaron runes switched from 공증 to 스증.

sources.title: 토벌 브시커 스가 효율 좀 알려 주세여
sources.titleEn: Tell me about Bright Seeker skill-haste efficiency in the raid
sources.summaryEn: At Seeker 스가 40 all 6 beams hit the boss, but at 58.6 the drones spawn while adds appear, so 1–2 beams go elsewhere and not 100% of damage lands on the boss. Asks whether to push to 60 or trade 3 스가 for 스증. A commenter compares the formula to LoL cooldown (needs 300 'cooldown' for URF-like); author says they have 300 and asks what 스가 that is.

sources.title: 토벌 체리덱 써도 시커가 자꾸 옆으로 빠지는데
sources.titleEn: Even with the Cherry deck my Seeker keeps drifting to the side
sources.summaryEn: Seeker drifts outward despite zero move-speed on gear and runes; asks if infinite retry is the answer. One reply: yes. Another: without move speed it shouldn't drift; give Pinot Noir some move speed via sugar rune.

sources.title: 연구 이거 뚫는거 존나 크네
sources.summaryEn: A guild-research HP +30% node added 60M power, but the author still dies at 17 s (research stone dungeon stage 612, Crumble Lv176).

sources.title: [📚정보] 스테덱은 바리+체콜 같이쓸거 아니면 체콜 비추함
sources.titleEn: Don't use Cherry Cola in stage decks unless paired with Bari

sources.title: 이덱은 누가 발명햇냐
sources.summaryEn: Photo of the 17.59M defense deck that beat the poster: a Chain (연쇄) deck with Vampire, Twizzly Gummy, Dr. Bones, Schwarzwälder, Skating Queen (grants Chain synergy) and an evasion pet. Battle stats (75966): Vampire 1.78M, Pinot 979K, Twizzly 832K, Hound 620K, Ion 498K.

sources.title: 다시붙어봣다
sources.summaryEn: Poster's 17-18M Rye one-carry deck lost 3 of 3 to the chain/skeleton deck of 75982 despite 1,100 accuracy. Analysis in comments: Rye's first skill jumps toward the lone Schwarzwälder top-left and wastes itself there; the opponent's many sub-dealers (Schwarzwälder, Dr. Bones) take Rye's supports apart; a textbook counter.

sources.title: 30초 이후에 마카롱 버프 못받았는데 기갱 ㄷㄷ
sources.titleEn: New record even without Macaron buff after 30 s
sources.summaryEn: The author set a new record even though Macaron's buff never landed after 30 s. Damage varies even while the Seeker's buff holds, and the team no longer wipes after 17 s.

sources.title: [일반] 한달도 안된 뉴비인데 돌파력 <<<< 이거 강해지는 좀 심함?
sources.titleEn: Does Resolve raise power a lot?
sources.summaryEn: A player under a month old at stage 245 (blessing 11) saving coins: spend coins on Resolve only when a 35% line can no longer be held; banked coin rewards scale with stage, so late spenders get the most Resolve per chest (one player was at Resolve 775 at stage 168). Dough is capped by time, not stage.

sources.title: 400배까지는 쳤는데 1T치는 비법소스좀
sources.summaryEn: Melon Soda deck at 2.06G, 86?G (digits hidden) — later the same user (러유) hits 1T with the cherry deck (76580). Replies: use Panda; drop Melon, add Cheesecake and retry infinitely; infinite move-speed tuning.

sources.title: [일반] 유닠 장비 패키지는 진짜 유명한 가성비 패키지임
sources.titleEn: The Unique gear package is the famous value package
sources.summaryEn: The Unique gear package is known value but short-lived: oven 25 arrives fast, and the Rumble Arena's keys flooded dough, so Legendary weapons now last days.

sources.title: 시커 4성 토벌 점수 맥시멈 얼마임?
sources.titleEn: What's the max raid score with a 4-star Seeker?
sources.summaryEn: Asks the ceiling with a 4★ Seeker. Answers: at least 200배; 4★ vs 5★ differs only ~30%; 4★ 200–250배, 5★ 350–400배.

sources.title: [일반] tssr 나올때마다 올10성 하는애들은 돈이 얼마나많은거냐
sources.summaryEn: Taking every monthly TSSR to 10★ means about 1,000,000 KRW a month plus weekly packs.

sources.title: 명중집중 ㅈㄴ 중요한 것 같은데 왜 스캠이라는거임
sources.titleEn: Accuracy/focus seems important; why call it a scam?
sources.summaryEn: Stage-focused; notes accuracy/focus are not effective Arena stats.

sources.title: 일반 아레나 깔개들은 방덱 열어놓는게 서로 좋다
sources.titleEn: Low-ranked players: leave your defense open
sources.summaryEn: Deliberately weak defense (850K: five cookies incl. Lv.1s) while attacking with a 5.96M team; 16th overall at Elite Master 1 (2,405 points). A loss on defense costs at most -5, a revenge win gives back more; weaker players climbing past you become revenge targets. Top-3 on the server at 3,007/2,804/2,739.

sources.title: 토벌장비도 따로 맞춰야되나??
sources.titleEn: Do I need a separate raid gear set too?
sources.summaryEn: Uses arena and stage presets; asks if raid needs its own. Replies: most share arena/raid; the difference is only whether you take crit res.

sources.title: 토벌 체리덱 700배
sources.summaryEn: 1T 312G at 1.8G team power = 728배 with a Cherry deck in which 석류/피노/정전/닼초/체리 are Lv.1 and 전갈 Lv.10, no move speed. Author explains the logic: Lv.1 cookies minimise the chance that cookies who shouldn't get Pomegranate's straw grab Milk's ATK buff first and scramble the ATK order; Pomegranate at Lv.1 because her level doesn't change the buff and it lowers power, which inflates the multiple ('배수딸'). ATK order 우유 > 브시 > 피겨 > 카롱 > 실론 > 치케, 전갈 at least 10% below 6th because the Wasabi pet adds 8% ATK on entry. Best run is lucky; average 600–800배, and a guildmate with the same deck gets ~200배.

sources.title: [일반] 스테 전투력 확높이고싶으면 현질 어떤거 하면 좋음??
sources.titleEn: What to buy to raise stage power fast?
sources.summaryEn: Stage 176, 150M power, oven 25, weekly keys bought, plates 15/13/13 and the rest 10, Stellar 7 with 7 points at 55%, Resolve 606. Advice: plates are the best next buy; Stellar rises well but a 10-point shape must be redone later.

sources.title: [일반] 애들아 스테덱 무지성으로 투력만 올릴때
sources.summaryEn: The stat that shows the most power is whichever is lowest on your current stats (dc:56391); defense is rated low because defense has diminishing returns.

sources.title: 토벌에서 치저가 필요한가?
sources.titleEn: Is crit res needed in the raid?
sources.summaryEn: Author runs 피감치저 armor and wonders if 피감체력 is better. Split replies: 치저 is a 'scam' in raid; either way everyone dies at 17 s (Milk always dies there due to 열정페이); but one player on 피감치저 (arena shared) says Seeker survives to 8.33 s remaining and deals 100G+ after Milk dies; another tried 피감체력 and still couldn't survive.

sources.title: 토벌 메소덱 판다쓰냐 주머니쓰냐
sources.titleEn: Melon Soda raid deck: Panda or Pouch pet?
sources.summaryEn: Author used Panda for their record in the Melon Soda deck but thinks the Pouch (색동주머니) has better basic damage. A commenter uses Panda because of the move-speed setting and hit 867G at 1.57G power (~552배) with full retries Thu/Fri; says Pomegranate trolls more this season. Others: Pouch has higher lift-resistance and HP, placement differs because 띄저 differs; 'Pouch is Panda's upgrade'.

sources.title: 아레나 장비로 스가 18정도 챙겼는데 더챙겨야대냐?
sources.titleEn: Got ~18 haste from arena gear; need more?
sources.summaryEn: Has ~18 스가 from arena gear, asks whether to take 스증 instead. Replies: put haste on all 6 lines.

sources.title: 토벌 체리 덱 이게 한계네
sources.titleEn: Raid Cherry deck, this is my limit
sources.summaryEn: 162G 573M at 571.22M power (~285배) with a Herb-version Cherry deck; wants to swap Herb for Jungle Warrior but Milk dies too early. All move speed removed. Unusual: fillers at Lv.45–50 rather than Lv.1.

sources.title: 토벌 시커 5성 달면 확 달라짐?
sources.titleEn: Does 5-star Seeker change the raid a lot?
sources.summaryEn: At 1.17G power with a 4★ Seeker, correct ATK order and everyone alive to 22 s, can't pass 140G (~120배). Replies: 5★ Seeker goes from 2 to 3 drones; one did 171G at 631.98M with 5★; another went 170 → 250 on reaching 5★; another saw +25%; 'raid is a Seeker-only content'.

sources.title: [일반] 팀투력 3g 4g는 어케하는거임??
sources.summaryEn: One player reaches only 2G after opening Stellar 8, another 1.5G; a 3.6G account lists Stellar 8 with 6 points, every cookie at 10★ except Bari, Resolve 960 and plates averaging 17.

sources.title: 토벌 왼쪽 위 장비 스증치확 vs 스증치피
sources.titleEn: Raid top-left gear: amp+crit rate vs amp+crit dmg

They cleared 차원의 이면, but it gave no spec for conquest.

sources.title: 와레나 메달 모아야 하는데 복수작 할만함?

sources.titleEn: Is Skill Haste mandatory in Arena?
sources.summaryEn: Choosing between an Eternal necklace with crit RES 25.43% / Focus +111 / Skill Haste +3.40 and one with crit RES 26.06% / crit rate 9.38% / Skill AMP 5.62%. Consensus: never drop Skill Haste; the six right-side pieces are all Skill Haste. Dissent: Bari decks drop skill haste; make a separate preset.

sources.title: 아레나 치확 치피 차이 유의미함?
sources.titleEn: Crit rate vs crit DMG in Arena?
sources.summaryEn: Weapon choice: +21.39% crit rate / +8% Skill AMP vs +9.01% Skill AMP / +16.23% crit DMG. Answers split: take higher Skill AMP; crit rate always in Arena. One user claims crit rate over 100% overflows into stronger crits (official, up to 300%?) and crit RES cancels crit rate, so crit rate is the pick.

sources.summaryEn: Claim: Moon Rabbit only debuffs the front line, and outside Bari decks there are no dealers there. Replies: it's mandatory insurance, without it Oven kills in 2s; strong spenders punch through it anyway.

sources.title: 아레나 달토대신에 락스타 별로임?

sources.title: 아레나 들개 필수인가??

sources.title: 5번정도 1.3T 나오면 이게 내 고점인거지?
