sources.summaryEn: The author has 3G team power (~450×) and keeps getting 1.3T. Replies: at 2.6G one player got 1.5T; 600× should be normal; one went to 780× after more retries. Skill amp 6 lines plus skill haste 6 lines is expected. On the top-left gear piece, higher skill amp beats crit, and whether to take crit rate or crit dmg depends on crit rate after Macaron's buff (30 or more: crit rate, below: crit dmg).

sources.title: 토벌 기록용 420배

sources.summaryEn: Formation of the Seeker/Donut Rye version at 16.56M. Replies: surprisingly the Grapevine version is stronger, because against Bari or Rye decks the front-line Herb often dies first and Grapevine is backup healing. Seeker makes the deck weaker; only Skating↔Donut and Grapevine↔Rockstar are worth swapping.

Advice: max 피겨/실론 (and 치케), level down 체리/피노; too weak for 정전, use 허브; switch to even a new Wasabi pet; higher power also raises the multiple. Author: levelling everyone max gives under 10배.

sources.title: 토벌 세팅 질문 (스압)
sources.summaryEn: Author at 1.93G deck power (13G account) gets 387G 984M (~201배), usually 100–180G; Seeker haste 31 in battle; ~1 h retries a day. Screenshots give every cookie's level, stars and ATK, and all 9 gear items (Eternal +15/16): weapons 치확+스증 or 스증+치피, accessories with only two 스가 lines, armor all 피감+치저. Advice: Ceylon (Lv.98) is below Cheesecake in ATK, so level it to 100; 정전 needs 2–3 haste lines and heavy retries (high ceiling, big variance); try 허브 + Lv.1 Ceylon; get 6 haste lines from gear; remove any move speed; retry 2–3 hours or overnight macro.

sources.title: [일반] 투력 680m인데 더 올릴방법 없냐
sources.summaryEn: At 680M, blocked at 35% on 240-30, with Stellar, plates, lab stones and dough all spent: push at 35% and spend banked coins on Resolve only when it drops to 15%.

sources.title: [일반] ㅂㅅ겜 이면은 퀘안깨짐
sources.titleEn: The 'summon a boss' quest doesn't complete in the Rift

sources.title: 아레나 이온이랑 락스타 같이써도 돼?
sources.titleEn: Can Ion and Rockstar be used together?
sources.summaryEn: Ion's and Rockstar's shields stack; with 6 DR slots 'you basically don't die'. Lower-right Skill Haste + DR seen as standard; Rockstar runes all skill haste (asked).

sources.title: 아레나 전투력차이 이유가 뭐임
sources.summaryEn: Revenge target is a 26.19M, 3,251-trophy Bari-Oven-Cherry Cola deck (pets Holy Baby Drop, Hot Doggie, Icy Birdie all ★20); the poster's own 22.14M formation screen (preset '토벌') is the same 12 with King Choco Drop. Comments: Arena power is essentially gear and plate enhancement (+ sugar runes); slots with crit RES/accuracy instead of skill haste change displayed power. Own stars: Bari 7★ (2 pink + 3 yellow), Oven 9★, most of the rest 9-10★.

sources.title: 니들 서버는 이번주에 크럼블던전 몇명쳤냐
sources.titleEn: How many ran Crumble Dungeon on your server this week?
sources.summaryEn: Participants this week: 43 on the poster's server; replies 320 (a 200s server), about 300 (a 300s server), 169 (an early 200s server), 170 (a 500s server).

sources.title: 바리10성 아레나덱 호밀덱으로 잡을수있나??
sources.titleEn: Can a Rye deck beat a 10★ Bari Arena deck?
sources.summaryEn: A 4-season server #1 (Bari 6★, 9★ Rye) can beat the 10★ Bari #2 in Rumble with Rye but loses in regular Arena, because Rumble's +30% DR stops the one-shot; Rockstar already tried. Consensus in 18 comments: no Rye build beats a high-star Bari in regular Arena; 'top players are all Bari for a reason'.

sources.title: 아레나에서 호황이 강할수밖에 없는 이유
sources.titleEn: Why Rye is bound to be strong in Arena
sources.summaryEn: Rye panel out of battle: ATK 17,905, HP 143K, crit 89.77%, crit RES 92.20%, crit dmg 89.18%, DR 55.01%, speed 4. In battle: ATK 146K (~8.2x), HP 139K, crit 220.53%, crit dmg 267.85%, DR 45.37%. Shows how much the buff stack (Macaron, Pomegranate, Pinot, Cheesecake etc.) inflates Rye.

sources.title: 아레나 덱 조언좀..
sources.summaryEn: Server #2 (18.24M) vs #1 (19.37M) Bari-Oven-Cherry Cola defense whose cookie levels are visible: Herb Lv.70, Ion Lv.1, Hound Lv.1, others Lv.100. Poster dies at once even with Donut and Rockstar. Advice: drop Passion Pay for Health Insurance or Rapid Promotion + Armor Repair, run DR/HP pets; that let him survive but then he lacked damage. 'Oven/Cherry Cola with high stars and enhancement one-shot you whatever DR you stack.'

sources.title: [✋️질문] 하다보니 재밋어서 55000에 광고제거 살라는데
sources.titleEn: Buying the 55,000 pack and Ad Removal: what else?
sources.summaryEn: TSSRs use their own currency; expect about 30,000 KRW per copy, 200,000–300,000 KRW for 5★ and close to 1,000,000 for 10★. The 5.5 permanent plus the 15,000 monthly gacha membership gets each SSR pickup to 7–8★; the weekly 6,000 KRW key pack is the most efficient; growth here is driven by dungeons.

sources.title: [일반] 다른건 모르겠는데 진짜 오븐 29만들기 개빡세네...
sources.summaryEn: Oven 29 (the mercenary band level 4 gate) takes about a month from start with every key pack bought; one player is at oven 24 at stage 210; the Rumble Arena's 30 keys made it easier.

sources.title: [일반] 공증 30퍼까지 얼마나 걸리려나
sources.titleEn: How long to the ATK 30% node?
sources.summaryEn: Lab steps near research 100 cost 5–6M research stones each; at research dungeon 644 a player expects one step every three days.

sources.title: 크럼블 던전 379G 고점 갱신 ㅅㅅ
sources.summaryEn: 스미노프TFT: result 379,313,179,520 at 15G 579M, 1st, 0.000 s left. Lineup as in his guide. Moon Rabbit is fine, Bari must never be used: Milk runs to heal her and the damage loss left him barely past 100G. Replies: filler levels don't matter as long as the beam-relevant top six ATK ranks stay put and the forbidden cookies stay out; Macaron runs Skill AMP.

sources.title: 크럼블 던전열쇠는 왜사는거야
sources.summaryEn: Replies: extra keys are for record attempts when fighting for the top three (which pay speed-up tickets), and for the 70-run mission.

sources.title: [일반] 8스텔라 삼각형 완성하니깐
sources.summaryEn: Completing the three-point triangle on the 8th constellation took party power from 2G to 2.2G.

sources.title: 600번대 촌장 와레나 엘마 왔다
sources.summaryEn: 뻐커 (S0619) got the first Elite Master 5 promotion of the season (2,000 gems) with a 12.38M Bari deck at 1,967th, beating 15.86M (1,948th). Thanks to Bari he can fight players from older servers. A commenter calls the tier-up gem rewards stingy.

sources.title: 근데 호밀덱이 바리덱 카운터는 맞아?
sources.titleEn: Is the Rye deck really the Bari counter?
sources.summaryEn: A Rumble top-10/50 player sees almost no Rye decks up there and has never lost to one. Commenters: Rye is strong to upper-mid, Bari stronger at the very top because its three main dealers are 2 TSSR + 1 SSR vs Rye's SR carry; a 12M Bari deck beat 19M Rye decks.

sources.title: [일반] 소과금은 현질할 이유가 사라진듯
sources.titleEn: No reason left for a light spender to buy
sources.summaryEn: Stage 313, 3G+, blessing 7 and a half: pulls only add mileage, SSRs are all 10★, Chocosteel/Syrup end in shatters, TSSR 7★+ needs heavy spending; reaching 328 at that power would take about 3,000,000 KRW. In hindsight the poster would stay at Ad Removal + Unique + 5.5.

sources.title: [✋️질문] 반죽을 계속 깔수록 장비 투력이 높아짐?
sources.titleEn: Does opening more dough raise gear power?
sources.summaryEn: Gear level caps at oven level × 3.

sources.title: 이거머임?? 와레나
sources.summaryEn: A revenge screen against an anonymous 2000+ opponent shows 3 of the 12 defense slots as sleeping-face placeholders and a win reward of 30-34 points. The poster's own attack team at 2,118 pts is the standard 12 at Lv.100. A commenter says names are hidden from Elite Master to stop sniping.

sources.title: 이면 6단계 15% 비틀기 성공
sources.summaryEn: Text only: Rift level 6 (the Cake Hound Pack, per rift-bosses.json) cleared at 15%, with the lineup Macaron, Brightseeker, Cheesecake, Pomegranate, Skating Queen, Witchberry, Bari, Tiger Lily (정전), Rockstar, Milk, Cherry Cola, Dark Choco. A commenter asks for the pets; no answer.

sources.title: 이면 15퍼 쿨민
sources.summaryEn: In-Rift screenshot of Noah (Lv.190, Rift rank 86th): '차원의 이면 12단계', Cool Mint at 0.000%, header 20G 453M 993K, gear preset '스가x'. The poster says this deck clears everything at 15% except the Cake Hound Pack; Werehound Princess and GingerCraven might fall with a lot of time but aren't worth it. In the comments the poster clears the three trucks by dropping Herb or Cherry Cola for Dark Choco and stacking Devil's and Dark Choco's DEF shred, pushing them to 9 or 7 o'clock; Devil survives thanks to the Rift buff.

sources.title: 이면 와서 어이없었던거
sources.titleEn: What baffled me on reaching the Rift
sources.summaryEn: The level-10 clear frame is time-limited; GingerCraven is practically impossible at 15%, so you idle until 35%; the all-server #1 stood at level 20 for over 30 hours.

sources.title: 와레나 익명은 뭐임?
sources.summaryEn: Image 1 is a defense-log entry: an anonymous 2000+ attacker running the standard 12 with Hot Doggie, King Choco Drop and Holy Baby Drop beat the poster's defense (방어 실패 −1). Image 2 is the revenge screen: the same kind of defense with 2 of 12 slots hidden and a win reward of 35-39 points, against the poster 센구 (S0387, 11.3M, 1,931 pts) whose attack team is the standard 12 at Lv.100. A commenter says this shows above 2,000 points.

sources.title: 호밀덱<<락스타가 맞는거같은데??
sources.titleEn: Rockstar is right for the Rye deck
sources.summaryEn: With Rockstar in, the poster's Rye deck survives the Bari-Oven opening burst. Comments: one dropped Skating, Donut, Seeker and Herb and beat a 10★ Bari for the first time, but after ~50 fights says it can't beat a properly set Bari deck; a commenter points to the Rumble #8 deck (Macaron, Rye, Pinot, Cheesecake, Pomegranate, Grapevine, Milk, Hound, Rockstar, Ion, Moon Rabbit + Lime). The image is a sticker.

sources.title: 님들 아레나 명중은 꼭 맞추샘
sources.summaryEn: Evasion-deck user (17th, 12.47M) beats a 14.08M 45th player; remembers low-accuracy players and farms them. Vampire's panel: accuracy 1,093, evasion 1,223.7, evasion rate 24.40%, focus 1,268.84, resist 658.1. Gear preset '아레나 회피' with +15 pieces. Raw evasion 1,200 plus Mango Toucan 10% is about 1,300; magic-object types sit at 80 base evasion, others 100+.

sources.title: 와레나 상위권 갈수록 회피덱 많네
sources.titleEn: More evasion decks higher up in Rumble
sources.summaryEn: Evasion decks get more common higher up the Rumble ladder, so the poster is going to add two accuracy lines.

sources.title: 8단계 비틀기성공
sources.summaryEn: A 15% 'twist' (비틀기) clear of Rift level 8. The screenshot is the in-Rift battle screen of 카린 (Lv.188, Rift rank 188th): header team power 12G 152M 606K, boss 초코크림 늑대 망치공주 at 0.000%, '차원의 이면 8단계', fight clock 1.100. 카린 is the player who cleared 328-30 at 4.00G (dc:76835, first round), so the Rift header shows about three times their lobby power.

sources.title: 회피덱 맛있네
sources.summaryEn: Battle at 16.47M (7th) vs 17.11M (6th): the poster's Rye shows evasion 1,386.25, accuracy 660.12, focus 993.26, resist 680.7. Levels are tuned so Rye gets Pomegranate's beam since it is not all ATK runes. Pets Cheese drop, Hot Doggie, Rapid Fire pet; perks Armor Repair + Passion Pay. A commenter: an accuracy-built opponent shreds it.

sources.title: 방금 와레나 투력 10m차이 이김;
sources.titleEn: Just won Rumble at a 10M power gap
sources.summaryEn: 우이's 12.48M deck beat a 22.72M deck (Bari, Brightseeker, Oven, Rye and the standard supports). Crepe and then Rye died first, but Vampire and Pinot chipped the rest down; the poster credits Milk (2,893,597 healing) and Lime (1,408,960). The win gave +8 points (2,390, 983rd) and 175 medals. Commenters say both sides were under-built (Stella not unlocked, Bari 4★).

sources.title: 나보다 투력낮은 바리뽑은 새끼들한테 지는 섭1위들 필독.txt
sources.titleEn: For server #1s losing to lower-power Bari players
sources.summaryEn: Server #1's fix without pulling Bari: Rye deck with Espresso swapped for Rockstar, Milk captain, 3 tanks + Armor Repair, pets King Choco Drop + 'the new pet' + Holy Baby Drop; Brightseeker does the cutting. Unsure what happens if Bari-Oven-Cherry Cola adds Adventurer.

sources.title: 와레나에 회슝좍 방덱 갑자기 늘었네
sources.titleEn: Evasion defenses suddenly common in Rumble
sources.summaryEn: Evasion defenses suddenly increased, but their pets give them away, so the attacker switches to the stage gear preset and beats them. Replies: one runs no pet because 1,300 evasion is enough; another explains that without Fluffy Cheese Cat Vampire bites fewer times and without the evasion pet the dodging is less reliable, so evasion decks get swept by 3-charger Bari decks unless they are much stronger.

sources.title: 회피 1400인데 명중600한테 개쳐맞는데?
sources.summaryEn: Test with 1,400 evasion still gets hit by 600-accuracy attackers. Replies: one accuracy line breaks an evasion set; it only works against zero accuracy lines; a commenter thought each 100 evasion gave just under 10% miss.

sources.title: 이면 4단계 3트럭 뭐임 ㅅㅂ????
sources.titleEn: What is Rift level 4, the three trucks?
sources.summaryEn: A player stuck at level 4 asks whether the three trucks can be beaten at 15%. Two commenters say they cleared it at 15%; one adds that if it won't go, clear it at the next 차원의 힘 level, and that the trucks come back several times.

sources.title: 와레나 쌀숭이덱 그마찍먹함
sources.titleEn: Touched Grand Master with my Rye deck
sources.summaryEn: 길룡부하 reached Rumble Grand Master 3 for the first time this season (4,000 gems) at 101st with a 22.54M Rye deck, beating a 28.14M opponent at 116th. The lineup on the battle screen is Macaron, Doughnut King, Cheesecake, Grapevine, Milk, Ion over Rye, Pinot, Pomegranate, Rockstar, Hound, Moon Rabbit, all Lv.100. Asked his oven level, he answers 37.

sources.title: 근데 와레나 랭커들 바리덱 이거 호밀덱으로 잘잡는거 맞나;;
sources.titleEn: Do Rye decks really beat Rumble rankers' Bari decks?
sources.summaryEn: Rumble: a 4.5M Rye deck lost 5 in a row to a 5.01M Bari deck (4.94M, 3,472 in the log). Comments: Rye that beats Bari is usually 8★+; Rye must be top-3 ATK for the first beam (tune Pinot's level down); get merc level 4 for the DR 10% perk; one commenter with plate and gear all +15 holds regular-Arena GM top 10 at 축4.

sources.title: 이면은 그나마 들개 쿨민은 15%컷 가능하네
sources.titleEn: In the Rift, at least the Cake Hounds and Cool Mint go at 15%
sources.summaryEn: Text: Bari plus pierce (관통) cookies herd and kill the mob-heavy levels well; 'if you can't make 35%, try 15% with a skill-AMP/skill-haste preset'. In the comments the author says single-target bosses are practically impossible at 15% (once saw a boss down to 15% HP, gave up over the retries); GingerCraven is easy at 35% with Brightseeker, Scorpion and Cherry Cola alone; the Cake Hounds and Cool Mint fell at 15% to a Bari–Oven Wanderer–Skating Queen plus Witchberry–바궁–Rockstar combination; the Werehound Princess and the three trucks are hard at 15%.

sources.title: 호밀포도락스타 아레나 좋더라
sources.titleEn: Rye + Grapevine + Rockstar is good in Arena
sources.summaryEn: The poster attacks with Rye + Grapevine + Rockstar and holds defense with a Bari deck against a rival for village chief. Commenters ask for the deck and say their Rye decks get cut by Bari decks.

sources.title: 이면 투력 60G 돌파 ㅇㅅㅇ
sources.summaryEn: 다함께차차차 (Lv.191, Rift rank 11th, 축복 Lv.10, 돌파력 1114): in-Rift header 63G 232M 704K at 차원의 힘 Lv.19 (366/14,820), '차원의 이면 25단계 반복 중'. Asked for their stage team power, the poster answers 'about 6.4'. Level 25 is a GingerCraven level (the level cycle); its 35% line is 65.29G, so at 63.23G the player sits 2G under it.

sources.title: 이면 잘아는사람있어? 35%넘겼는대 딜이안드감
sources.titleEn: Anyone know the Rift? I'm past 35% but damage doesn't land
sources.summaryEn: 'Level-10 GingerCraven's 35% is about 16G; why does nothing land at 17G?' Reply: the 35% cut is 40% of recommended power. Level 10's 35% line is 18.76G (rift-levels.json), so at 17G the poster was in the 15% bracket and GingerCraven took no damage.

sources.title: (정보) 차원의 이면 정보, 전투력 컷
sources.titleEn: (Info) Dimensional Rift info and power cuts
sources.summaryEn: An info post: you need about 4G (328-30's 35% cut) to reach the Rift; inside, 차원의 힘 accrues at n per minute where n is the Rift level, and levelling it raises power; the structure is to raise power while idle, match each boss's 35% cut, and push. 'Some bosses fall at the 15% cut too: I took level 3, the Werehound Princess, at 15%.' Screenshots: 차원의 힘 Lv.4 (1,850/2,040) at 'level 4 repeating'; the Lv.4 effects (Rift ATK, DEF and HP amplification +30%, crit damage +90%, crit rate +30%, focus +15%, accuracy +20%); a table of the cuts per level (100%, 15% at 20%, 35% at 40%, 55% at 60%) for levels 1-25, which matches curated/rift-levels.json. Comments: the Rift's power is its own, from 차원의 힘; for 15% 'shred well' and stack Dark Choco to 10 with skill 2.

sources.title: 와레나 200위 호밀덱 푼다
sources.summaryEn: 도토리마스터 shares his 20.39M Rye deck at about 200th; Rye is still 8★ and he expects more at 9★. Against Bari decks Skating Queen wins more often than Grapevine, but in Rye mirrors Grapevine is better (poster). A commenter says this list tops out around 200th and is adding Brightseeker.

sources.title: 이건 아무리고민해도 방덱오픈이 맞다
sources.titleEn: Opening the defense deck is the right call
sources.summaryEn: Arena ranking (1st 3,460, 2nd 3,364, 3rd 3,362); the 4th and 5th defenses show grey hidden placeholders among their cards, and the poster (6th, 3,260) shows a single Lv.1 cookie as an 'open' defense so lower players can farm him. He can't beat the top 5 because of their spec. A commenter keeps an open defense to burn tickets on revenges and still gets top-75 rewards.

sources.title: 호밀덱으로 바리덱 카운터 치긴하는데 이게 맞나?
sources.titleEn: Countering Bari with Rye, but is this right?
sources.summaryEn: Two damage tables where the Rye dies almost at once but Pinot Noir carries: Pinot 1,567,946 and 1,582,031, Hound 1,118,505 and 673,232, Rye only 55,303 and 127,982. Opponents: Bari 1,383,770 / Oven 729,086 / Cherry Cola 513,905 with Crepe in the top 8, and Bari 1,926,485 / Oven 855,716 / Cherry Cola 386,611 with Hound. No server tags and the poster's '우리서버엔 10성이 업수우' point to regular Arena (L). Commenters: skill-haste Pinot with Chain is very strong (Chain 4 hits at 80-90% with crit-down, roughly every 1.5 s).

sources.title: 이면 11 12 비틀기 덱
sources.titleEn: Rift levels 11 and 12: the twist decks
sources.summaryEn: 카린 again (Lv.189): two in-Rift battle screenshots with the decks used to 'twist' levels 11 and 12. Level 11, 케이크 들개떼: header 17G 796M 59K, boss at 4%, clock 7.733. Level 12, 쿨링민트맛 쿠키: header 18G 398M 14K, boss 0.000%, clock 1.567. Both are the 15% bracket. Comments ask about level 8 (Werehound Princess) and level-10 GingerCraven at 17.2G, which deals no damage.

sources.title: 아레나 공격자 보정 100% 있는듯
sources.titleEn: There must be an attacker bonus in Arena
sources.summaryEn: Same power, same decks: 10/10 attacks win, 10/10 defenses lose against the same player. Says the same holds in Rumble. Two commenters agree.

sources.title: 아 3트럭 좃같네
sources.summaryEn: In-Rift screenshot of '차원의 이면 14단계': 폭주단 트럭 at 6% with the clock at 0.000, so the fight timed out. The poster confirms it was at 15% and still hasn't cleared it.

sources.title: 바리 걍 스킵 때려야지
sources.summaryEn: The poster will skip Bari: it is a Rumble one-trick that only works because Rumble's buff favours it, and the season rewards don't motivate him. Commenters: Bari will be used whenever an overpowered charger comes out since it buffs chargers; others say chargers are weak by design and new strong cookies will crowd Bari out.

sources.title: 8성 호밀로 10성 오방바리덱 컷
sources.summaryEn: Damage table (mode not shown): an 8★-Rye deck beat a 10★ Oven-Bari deck. Winner: Rye 2,075,605, Hound 1,007,613, Brightseeker 893,198, Macaron 398,708, Ion 115,517, Moon Rabbit 91,280, Pinot 34,070, Rockstar 1,546. Loser: Bari 2,360,779, Oven 1,276,558, Cherry Cola 339,171, Pinot 128,534, Macaron 119,026, Hound 18,114, Ion 12,964, Moon Rabbit 552. The Rye card shows 3 pink + 2 yellow stars (8★, matching the title); the enemy Bari card looks all pink (10★). No mode banner or formation is shown.

sources.title: 아레나 아무리봐도 공격 보정 있는거같음
sources.titleEn: Arena definitely seems to have an attacker bonus
sources.summaryEn: Regular-Arena defense log (trophy -2 per loss, 'revenge success'): the same 13.07-13.57M Rye deck (Lebmont) beat the poster's defense 7+ times while the poster wins every revenge with the same decks. Another loss is to an 18.77M Bari-Oven-Cherry Cola attacker. The dungeon menu in the screenshot already shows a '쟁탈전' tab next to 도전 던전 / 일일 던전.

sources.title: 이면 망치부인 트럭 15퍼
sources.titleEn: Rift Werehound Princess and truck at 15%
sources.summaryEn: Noah (Lv.191, Rift rank 88th) shows a 15% clear of Rift level 18, the Werehound Princess at 0.000%, header 29G 731M 961K. Conquest gear preset, the same pets, perks Passion Pay + Fast Promotion, levels adjusted so the buffs pile on Brightseeker, Rye and Cherry Cola and Brightseeker gets Macaron's. The truck is the hardest: without a knockback pet the formation collapses. A commenter reads the third pet as 색동 주머니 (launch).

sources.title: 와레나 1위도 우리섭이네
sources.titleEn: Rumble #1 is from our server too
sources.summaryEn: Top 3 on 2026-10-01 ~12:00: 凱凱の餅乾軍團 (S0298) 5,076, 슈퍼땅콩 (S0161) 4,968, Hazelicious (S0097) 4,889; 凱凱 is also #1 in S0298's power ranking at 6G 522M. The poster (지연, S0298) is Master 2 at 2,125 pts (top 52.53%), where promotion needs 2,000 pts and top 50.00% for 1,800 gems; the season-end timer reads 6d23h59m. Commenters expect the end to be decided by who has the most mileage for tickets.

sources.title: 이거 아레나 1등 따잇하는 방법 있음?
sources.titleEn: Any way to snipe the Arena #1?
sources.summaryEn: Server #2 (16.4M, 3,986) attacks the #1 (17.22M, 4,106, +13 on win) with the identical Bari-Oven-Cherry Cola deck and loses 10/10. Stars confirm the text: the poster's Bari is 9★ vs the #1's 8★ and Ion 10★ vs 9★; both Ovens are 5★ (poster's 5 yellow). The #1's defense shows 4 of 12 slots hidden. Advice: drop all skill haste on a Bari deck (upper-right crit rate + Skill AMP, lower-right DR + crit RES); Bari decks stack Skill AMP and crit rate and settle it on the first hit.

sources.title: 와레나 투력 12M 차이도 이기네
sources.titleEn: Won Rumble at a 12M power gap
sources.summaryEn: 도토리마스터's 20.86M Rye deck (272nd) beat a 32.27M Bari deck (162nd) with 19.967 s left. Damage: Rye 2,597,126, Hound 1,453,557, Pinot 1,247,337, Skating Queen 441,061 against enemy Bari 2,093,694, Oven 1,330,688, Cherry Cola 723,158. The poster asks whether the Oven–Bari deck is dead next season if it loses like this even with the Rumble buff; commenters split.

sources.title: 와레나 필승법
sources.summaryEn: Look for defenses with the evasion pet Mango Toucan and hit them with the stage accuracy set; the defender can't hide pets. Replies: one has 1,500 evasion without the pet; another runs two accuracy lines plus a +20 bow even on his regular Arena set; a third is surprised a shield goes to +20.

sources.title: 아레나 6스가 스캠이었네
sources.titleEn: Six skill haste in Arena was a scam
sources.summaryEn: With the Rye deck, 6 skill-haste pieces couldn't survive the opening; switching the lower-right three to DR + crit RES (3 SH total) raised the win rate a lot. 14 comments agree; 'Bari decks are best at 0 SH, Rye or Seeker decks at 3 SH rather than 6'; mixing DR+crit RES and DR+HP is sturdier still.

sources.title: 뒷섭 아레나 2위인데 1위 잡을 방법 없을까
sources.summaryEn: Back-server #2. The #1 (15.96M, 3,637) seems to run a stage preset with 1,000+ accuracy and focus. The poster's 10.17M Rye deck with Grapevine, Rockstar and Crepe wins ~30%; he has tried Cheesecake, Crepe, Skating and Lime. Advice: drop lower-right skill haste for DR/HP; the poster will try 3 SH.

sources.title: 이면 비겁이 15%로 미는사람있음?
sources.summaryEn: Every reply: impossible; you wait two or three days.

sources.title: 바없찐들을 위한 호밀덱 공략
sources.titleEn: Rye deck guide for players without Bari
sources.summaryEn: Rumble Elite Master 1 (254th, 23.85M) guide; screenshots are Rumble (S0296, +175 defense log full of Bari-Oven-Cherry Cola attackers). Angel Cookie replaces Herb (Herb useless vs Bari; Angel with 3 skill-haste lines casts fast and its synergy holds the whole first turn); Lime added for Chain + crit synergy so Pinot does 1-1.5M per fight. Runes and gear given. 20 comments: several report Angel > Herb; one server-#1 charger user says ~80% win rate with it (mode unstated).

sources.title: 와레나 1등 짱깨새끼 축복12정도되나?
sources.summaryEn: The top guild has many whales but can't beat the #1. Replies: #1 keeps buying tickets with mileage; Arena is decided by tickets; Koreans will push on the last day.

sources.title: 아레나 딸크에소덱 아는사람?
sources.summaryEn: Proposes a fixed core (Macaron, Pinot, Cheesecake, Pomegranate, Espresso, Milk, Hound, Ion, Crepe, Herb) and asks for the rest among Donut, Rockstar, Moon Rabbit, Grapevine, Rye, Seeker, Skating. Replies: 'Crepe-Espresso is outdated in the current meta'; the poster heard it is fine vs Rye but bad vs Bari. No list is confirmed.

sources.title: 이면 20단 어케깸
sources.titleEn: How do you clear Rift level 20?
sources.summaryEn: Text: 'I came up to level 19 clearing at 15% with 차원의 힘 level 14; is level 20 an endless wait?' Commenters: GingerCraven is an endless wait / a speed bump.

sources.title: 회피덱 하나 만들어놔야겠다
sources.titleEn: I should build an evasion deck
sources.summaryEn: In Rumble the poster often gets reversed by defenses with over 1,100 evasion. Replies: build an accuracy + crit-resist set instead; one confirms a +20 shield; another has an evasion set and never used it.

sources.title: 다음버전 - 스킬, 연구소, 도감, 장비
sources.titleEn: [Leak] Next version: skills, lab, codex, gear
sources.summaryEn: Table diff for v1.5 plus Chardonnay's leaked sheet. Base ATK 133, DEF 60, HP 2,790, crit 10%, crit dmg 50%, move speed 3.5; receives Projectile Speed (탄속), gives Volley (다발). Skill '신록의 성역': 4 s cycle, 250% ATK damage, wall move speed 8.5; buff rows read crit rate +50%->100%/tick, Volley synergy 100%->200%, knockback resist 40%->60%, 5 s, while the Lv5 summary panel shows crit +100%, Volley synergy 100, knockback resist 100%, 5 s. Skill level rises with stars (Lv1 at 1-2 stars up to Lv5 at 9-10 stars). arenaBots (~152 rows) and arenaTiers (~29 rows) changed; Eternal gear, lab and codex images are not PvP.

sources.title: 와레나 방어에 명중 두줄 넣으니까
sources.titleEn: Two accuracy lines on the Rumble defense
sources.summaryEn: After putting two accuracy lines on his Rumble defense, evasion attackers all bounce off.

sources.title: 다음버전은 아님 - 쟁탈전
sources.summaryEn: Datamine of the unreleased 부스러기 쟁탈전 ('Crumb Clash', internal name Clash): a base-building PvP mode. Teams are 6 cookies plus hired gummy-bear units (tank/charge/ranged, 5 kinds x 10 levels); you capture strongholds (거점) on an exploration map and raid other users' bases; a guard room (경비실) holds the defense team; ELO rating (initial 100, constant 400, K 24), 29 tiers from Chocolate to Grand Master, seasons 1-10 named, daily ranking rewards at 00:00 KST, 40 s battle limit, 3 battle presets, a tech room whose research also applies to main stage, Crumble Dungeon, daily dungeons and Impolant Tower. The poster says it is NOT in v1.5 and most Clash tables were emptied/removed in the newest data.

sources.title: 아레나 존나 궁금한점
sources.titleEn: Does the attacker bonus really exist?
sources.summaryEn: Always wins the revenge against whoever beat his defense, with identical deck, pets and perks. One commenter suggests the other side changed perks; another reports the same pattern.

sources.title: 아레나 투력 2배차이가 이겨지는 거였구나
sources.titleEn: You can win at 2x power deficit in Arena
sources.summaryEn: Regular '시즌 5 아레나' battle, 6.92M (15th) vs 15.49M (13th): at 28.5 s left the banner reads '종료 임박 - 피해량이 증가합니다' (ending soon, damage increases). The poster says he attacked only to refresh and sometimes wins at a 2x power deficit; the screenshot shows the banner, not the result.

sources.title: 차원의 이면 1단계 깨니가 인원수 나오네?
sources.titleEn: Clearing Rift level 1 shows how many are in
sources.summaryEn: The all-server Rift ranking at about 02:38 on 2026-10-03: 1st 군무원 and 2nd 홍백련 at level 39, 3rd 스타 at 34; 96th to 98th at level 23, 99th and 100th at 22; the poster 687th at level 1. A commenter says 400 players were in the Rift the day before.

sources.title: 아레나 14m으로 27m 이기기
sources.summaryEn: Regular Arena win (14th, 3,809 trophies, +11) by a 14.38M evasion deck over a 27.35M Bari-Oven-Cherry Cola deck. Damage: Rye 1.80M, Crepe 1.06M, Vampire 687K, Pinot 552K, Hound 294K vs Oven 1.60M, Bari 1.52M, Macaron 428K, Pinot 287K, Cherry Cola 242K. 'If you survive Bari-Oven's first turn you win; if one or two die you lose.'

sources.title: 이계 4단계부터 벽느껴지네
sources.titleEn: Hitting a wall from Rift level 4
sources.summaryEn: 도토리마스터 (Rift rank 697th, 축복 Lv.6) at Rift level 4: the Rowdy Truck at 61% with 4.333 on the clock, header 5G 366M 699K. Commenters: pull the trucks to 7 or 11 o'clock; with a skill-haste set it goes at 15% too; pets Continuum Cog, Octo Wasabi, Hot Doggie; the routine is 'levels 1-4 at 15%, park at GingerCraven, kill it at 35%, repeat'.

sources.title: 아레나 공격 보정있냐 씨발
sources.titleEn: Is there an attack bonus in Arena?
sources.summaryEn: Another attacker-advantage complaint; 12 comments mostly agree (server #2-#4 players never lose revenges but keep losing defenses). One commenter claims it differs per device (unsupported).

sources.title: 축 5.8 차원의 이면 입성
sources.summaryEn: 신성한바티칸 enters the Rift with Bari and Brightseeker at 3★ (SSRs but Cherry Cola at 9-10★), Stellar 8-4, Oven 38, plates +15/+16, 돌파력 1012. On entry the Rift screen shows 차원의 힘 Lv.1 (0/30), '차원의 이면 1단계 반복 중', header 4G 78M 24K, gear preset '스테'. Also pushed main stages at 15%, but only on desert and lava maps; matching the power cut with 3★ Bari and Brightseeker took long. The same poster's dc:80390 tries the Werehound Princess at 15%.

sources.title: 이면 비겁말고는 전부 15% 되는거임?
sources.titleEn: Does everything but GingerCraven go at 15% in the Rift?
sources.summaryEn: 신성한바티칸 (entered the Rift the same day, dc:80338) can't get the Werehound Princess below 36% at 15% with Brightseeker 3★, even with Pomegranate's ATK order fixed in the conquest gear set. A commenter: within about 20% HP left, a 차원의 힘 level-up pushes it through; another: most who pushed at 15% are early entrants with TSSRs at 10★.

sources.title: 이면 20단계 치케 마카롱 넣고 뻥투 35퍼인데 안깨지노
sources.titleEn: Rift level 20 with Cheesecake and Macaron, padded to 35%, won't clear
sources.summaryEn: Level 20 (GingerCraven) fails even at 35% with padded power; the poster will level 차원의 힘 once more.

sources.title: 바리 ㅈ으로 보는애들 많네
sources.summaryEn: A player oscillating around 50th says he has never seen a Rye deck in the upper ranks: Bari with SSR Skill DMG runes plus high Skill DMG from gear cuts Rye at the start, and he rates Bari above Brightseeker. Commenters: of course Rumble is full of Bari since the charge buff favours it; judge in Season 2; Bari gets dropped once the next TSSR arrives.

sources.title: 와레나 상위권애들 바리 슈가룬 스증으로몰빵함?
sources.titleEn: Do top players stack Skill DMG on Bari?
sources.summaryEn: Asks whether top Rumble players put all Skill DMG on Bari's sugar runes or mix in Skill Haste. One answer: Skill DMG is the main stat, compromising with one crit DMG or ATK line. Another saw a Bari with about 230 crit rate unbuffed in Arena and wonders if that comes from sugar runes.

sources.title: 그냥 바리덱 호밀덱 딱 이거 같은데
sources.titleEn: Bari deck vs Rye deck, in one line
sources.summaryEn: Poster's ordering: well-set Bari > well-set Rye >>>> plain Bari > plain Rye. Most of the 15 comments agree ('정답'; performance Bari, value Rye). In the thread a commenter adds that Bari under 5★ is a junk deck that Rye eats, and another defines a 'set' Bari deck as 230%+ crit rate unbuffed so it still crits through Moon Rabbit. One commenter disagrees that plain Bari beats plain Rye.

sources.title: 바리 꼭 돌격3세팅 안해도되는 것 같음
sources.summaryEn: Running Oven + Bari plus one high-value flex beats three chargers; the 3-charger version lost to the same opponent. Comments: '2 chargers, then pick Rye, Espresso or Crepe by opponent'; the poster keeps Crepe; Crepe has the highest floor. The image is Oven Wanderer art.

sources.title: 형들 아레나 이거보다 강한덱있음?
sources.titleEn: Any Arena deck stronger than this?
sources.summaryEn: A low-power server leader (7.22M) now runs the same Bari-Oven-Cherry Cola deck as a 6.09M chaser after his 10★ Brightseeker deck 'melted', and asks whether to go evasion or 10★ Bari. Comment advice: vs Bari decks swap Ion, Oven and Herb for Skating Queen, Cherry Cola and Seeker so Skating takes Bari's buff and kills the diving Bari; Herb is shaky vs Bari; evasion decks are a scam unless built hard with Vampire; 'go 2-charger Bari-Oven and put Rockstar in Cherry Cola's slot'; Apple Rabbit pet is good unless facing evasion.

sources.title: 와레나 순위권들 바리덱에 뱀파 같이 쓰던데 이유가 머임?
sources.titleEn: Why do Rumble rankers put Vampire in Bari decks?
sources.summaryEn: Rumble rankers from about 50th to 10th run Bari-Oven decks with Vampire in place of Cherry Cola, roughly half and half. One commenter guesses Vampire lowers the enemy's accuracy so the opening survivors can't turn the fight. dc:80772 asks whether Bari, not Milk, is top ATK at the very top.

sources.title: 아레나 호밀덱 카운터는 뭘까
sources.titleEn: What counters the Arena Rye deck?
sources.summaryEn: A Skating Queen + Grapevine Rye deck beats Bari decks easily but gets crushed by the same Rye base (Macaron, Pinot, Moon Rabbit, Ion) with Rockstar plus Crepe or Donut. Replies: weak to Espresso decks; a well-set Bari deck shreds it (the poster's Bari is only 2★); 'put Angel in Herb's slot'.

sources.title: 붕슨마냥 호밀 빨간약 먹고있었네...
sources.summaryEn: Rye must be top-3 in ATK to take Pomegranate's beam, but was behind Milk, Skating Queen and Ion. Comments: ATK order inside Arena differs from the order outside; the Rapid Fire pet's ATK bonus must be counted. The image is a sticker.

sources.title: 아레나 와레나 방어 지금 버그있냐 진짜
sources.titleEn: Is defense bugged in Arena and Rumble?
sources.summaryEn: Lost 5 points on defense but a revenge only gives 3; loses defenses to players it beats in under 5 s. Same in Rumble.

sources.title: 와레나 이거 머임 ??
sources.summaryEn: Revenge screen against an anonymous 2000+ defense with 3 of 12 slots hidden and a win reward of 25-29 points. The poster's own attack team (6.08M, 2,001 pts) is an Oven–Bari deck with Brightseeker and Strawberry Crepe. A commenter says the blind starts at Elite Master.

sources.title: 호밀덱 허브 대신 천사 ㄱㅊ ?
sources.titleEn: Angel instead of Herb in a Rye deck?
sources.summaryEn: Asks about dc:79238's Angel-for-Herb swap. A user running it says it is sturdy and fine, and the deck doesn't need much 다발. Without King Choco Drop, a commenter points out 뽀글방울 has higher numbers than 색동 주머니, and the poster switches. The images are a dccon and the 79238 link preview.

sources.title: 아레나방덱 단장복지 적용 안되고있는거 아님?
sources.titleEn: Aren't merc-captain perks failing to apply on Arena defense?
sources.summaryEn: Revenge log shows the poster beating the same attackers who broke his defense, and the in-game Arena help: 'In Arena only some growth applies: cookie level-up and promotion, pet ownership effects, codex, gear, plate enhancement and sugar runes.' Merc perks (용병단 복지) are not in that list. The poster jokes the devs will 'fix' perks applying at all. Three comments agree. The official 10/8 notes add a help-text line about merc effects in Arena (dc:82166).

sources.title: 바리8성은 호밀이 넘보면 안되냐
sources.summaryEn: Rye deck loses to 8★ Bari even with Armor Repair, 10★ King Choco Drop, a ★19 DR bird and the Rapid Fire pet. Comments: at equal spec 8★ Bari wins; 'Rye is OK up to 6★ Bari, can't win from 7★'; one says with Angel the Rye deck beats up to 8★; one says at similar spec the attacker wins either way.

sources.title: 아레나 호밀덱 정석
sources.summaryEn: A question, not a confirmed standard: 'Is this the standard?' Macaron, Rye, Pinot, Cheesecake, Pomegranate, Skating Queen, Rockstar, Milk, Hound, Ion, Angel, Moon Rabbit; pets King Choco Drop, Hot Doggie, Icy Birdie; perks Passion Pay + DR 10%. No comments.

sources.title: 바없찐들을 위한 오방호밀덱 공략2탄(약간의 예능)
sources.titleEn: Oven-Rye deck for players without Bari, part 2
sources.summaryEn: Rumble EM1 (168th, 30.46M) Oven + Rye deck: give Oven the captain and top ATK so it out-ranks Milk, run 6 skill haste because ~90% of Bari-Oven decks run none, so your Oven dives first and the enemy Bari and Oven chase it while Crepe and Rye kill them. No Hound (its push would break the formation). Needs Oven 6★+ and Rye top-3 in ATK. Perks: 3-tank DR + General Perks. Rumble defense log shows mostly successes vs Bari decks.

sources.title: 그래서 호밀덱 정석이 뭐임?
sources.titleEn: So what's the standard Rye deck?
sources.summaryEn: Own 'my attack team' screen (preset 1) of a Rye one-carry deck, every cookie Lv.100, Rye 8★ and most others 9-10★. Replies: Donut King -> Skating Queen and Herb -> Angel (Herb gets cut too early; Angel runes Skill Haste + DR); one prefers Donut over Skating for win rate.

sources.title: 아레나 방어실패는 심증적으로 복지미적용이 범인임?
sources.titleEn: Is perks-not-applied the culprit for defense losses?
sources.summaryEn: Short thread; two commenters suspect the same. No evidence.

sources.title: 아레나 공방덱 차이는 배치구도임
sources.titleEn: The attack/defense difference is the layout
sources.summaryEn: Claims that against the same opponent the battle layout differs when you are the attacker vs the defender, which decides the result, and that perks do apply (check by tapping enemy cookies in battle).

sources.title: 와레나 상점 이거 초기화 없지?
sources.summaryEn: Nothing left to buy; the poster assumes the shop won't reset this patch. The one reply says it resets monthly.

sources.title: 와레나 오방바리덱 장비 답지가 뭐임?
sources.titleEn: What's the gear answer for Oven–Bari?
sources.summaryEn: The poster heard he should drop Skill Haste on his Oven–Bari deck, and despite good sugar runes he still gets pushed back. The only reply is a link.

sources.title: 념글 천사덱 뭐냐ㅋㅋㅋ10m차이를 따먹네
sources.titleEn: The featured Angel deck beats a 10M gap
sources.summaryEn: Rumble Season 1 battle at 26.8 s: the Angel/Lime Rye deck of dc:79238 (24.74M) against 35.46M; the poster says it beats a 10M gap. Comments: keep it secret until season end; Angel survives where Herb dies at once with Cheesecake; pets Hot Doggie, Choco Drop, Icy Birdie.

sources.title: 아레나 천사덱 ㄹㅇ 좋네
sources.titleEn: Angel deck in Arena is really good
sources.summaryEn: Angel deck wins almost everything unless Bari/Oven get lucky. A commenter says Angel users explode in regular Arena and get revenge-farmed, and it may work better in Rumble. The image is unrelated art.

sources.title: 아레나 티켓 이거 줄지를않네
sources.titleEn: My Arena tickets never go down
sources.summaryEn: Screenshot of regular Arena '시즌 5' on 2026-10-06: server top 3 at 4,457 / 4,031 / 3,934 trophies; the #1 (mari) and #2 (저녁별) profile icons show a white, Bari-like portrait, the #3 (香蕉王) a green slime. The poster is Grand Master 3, 12th, 3,423; promotion needs 3,000 trophies and top 10 overall for 6,000 diamonds. Comments: heavy players run 40-60 Arena fights a day; open your defense with a junk cookie and farm revenges to burn tickets.

sources.title: 아레나 방어가 존나 이상함
sources.summaryEn: Wins every revenge against players it lost defenses to.

sources.title: 회피셋 쓰는 사람들 아레나 얼마까지 이겨짐?
sources.titleEn: How far does an evasion set carry you?
sources.summaryEn: At ~1,200 evasion the poster loses even to attackers with 500-600 accuracy who are 3-4M stronger. Replies: raw evasion matters little without Vampire landing its accuracy debuff (which needs focus) and Peach (복숭아) evading forever to break the front line; a commenter whose server #1 runs 10★ Bari-Oven with 1,400 evasion says his counter preset with Skill AMP/accuracy lines (about 1,300 accuracy) crushes it; in regular Arena people see the same faces and quickly bring accuracy presets.

sources.title: 쿠키 배치 순서 (덱편성 / 샤르도네 포함)
sources.titleEn: Cookie placement order by range (incl. Chardonnay)
sources.summaryEn: Datamined auto-placement priority by range (higher = further back; ties go left-first): 7 Macaron, Wind Archer; 6 Lemon, Brightseeker, Cherry, Milky Way, Cheerleader; 5.5; 5.25 Oven Wanderer, Chardonnay; 5 ... Scorpion, Cream ...; 4.75 Donut King, Rye; 4.5 Pancake, Melon Soda, Licorice; 4.25 Cheesecake, Pinot Noir; 4 Espresso, Coffee, Schwarzwälder, Witchberry, Grapevine, Skating Queen, Vampire, Akama, Pomegranate; 3.75 Strawberry Shortcake, Twizzly; 3.5 Adventurer, Blueberry bird; 3 ...; 2.5 ... Princess Bari; 2.25 Mint Choco; 2 ... Ion, Hound, Milk, Rockstar, Lime; 1.75 ...; 1.5 ... Cherry Cola, Dark Cherry, Angel, Strawberry Crepe, Cool Mint, ...; 1.25 ... Herb ...; 1 Moon Rabbit, ... Tea Knight, Dr. Bones; 0.75 gummy. Comments: Macaron targets range-synergy receivers first, then highest ATK; synergy+ATK > synergy > ATK for buff targeting; spawn order may also follow power.

sources.title: 바리 성급 중요함?
sources.summaryEn: A player with a 2★ Bari asks whether Bari is only usable in Rumble at 7★ or more. One answer: even 7★ gets torn apart by Rye decks; usable from 8★. Another: if you haven't pulled it by now, skip it.

sources.title: 오방바리덱 프리셋 0스가야?
sources.summaryEn: Proposes Skill AMP 6, crit rate 5, accuracy 1, DR 6, crit RES 6 for an Oven-Bari preset. Reply: no accuracy needed; 6 Skill AMP, 6 crit rate, 6 crit RES, 6 DR.

sources.title: 누비 아레나 동투력한테 개처발리는데
sources.titleEn: Newbie losing to equal-power Arena players
sources.summaryEn: A 20-day, 2.23M account loses to 1.5M players within 15 s at 2x. Replies: it's gear substats; Bari deck needs Bari 5★+ and high-star Oven, otherwise run Rye; a Bari-Oven preset needs no skill haste: Skill AMP + crit rate / Skill AMP + crit rate or crit dmg / DR + crit RES or HP / DR + crit RES; breakthrough, fame, research and stellar link don't apply in Arena; presets are changing anyway.

sources.title: 와레나 엘마로 마감하겠다
sources.summaryEn: The poster ends the season 2,339th at 2,591 pts in Elite Master 1 (20.08M); promotion needs 3,000 pts and overall 100th for 4,000 gems, which he could buy with mileage but won't. Commenters: everyone from about 101st to 2,300th is Elite Master 1 with the same reward, so there is no reason to push.

sources.title: 왜케 UI가 불편하냐
sources.titleEn: Why is the UI so inconvenient
sources.summaryEn: Rumble has its own formations and you can't bulk-level there; levels can only be changed in the main cookie UI. The lobby screenshot (posted 10/7 06:43 KST) shows top 3 凱凱の餅乾軍團 6,929, 슈퍼땅콩 6,671, 인미 (S0360) 6,391, the 30% buff icon, and 1d5h19m to season end. The poster is Diamond 2 at 1,750 (73,909th); promotion at 1,800 pays 1,200 gems.

sources.title: 아레나에서 치피가 더 좋은거같은데
sources.titleEn: Crit damage seems better in Arena
sources.summaryEn: Poster (using Macaron) feels Skill AMP + crit damage beats the guide's Skill AMP + crit rate. Replies: Moon Rabbit stops crits; but Rye is not hit by Moon Rabbit, which is why Rye beats Bari; Bari decks should run crit rate; opponents wear crit RES by default, so crit rate is more efficient.

sources.title: 10월 8일(목) 업데이트
sources.titleEn: Oct 8 (Thu) update (screenshot of the official patch notice)
sources.summaryEn: Full screenshot of the official Naver cafe patch note for 2026-10-08. PvP-relevant items: new SSR Chardonnay Cookie; Rumble Arena (와글와글 아레나) Season 2 opens; cookie level cap raised to 120; Lv.79-100 exp cost cut with refunds; a free SSR Milk (바삭튼튼 소아과 의사 우유맛 쿠키) on day 7 of a new login event; and 'Arena help text supplemented: a note on how merc-corps (용병단) effects apply in Arena is added'. sources.summaryEn: Mechanics analysis with skill-card screenshots. Jungle Warrior's transform gives 다발 (multi-shot) synergy +3 to nearby allies, and Pomegranate's beam count scales with 다발 synergy. The author therefore gives Jungle Warrior 2–3 more skill-haste lines than Pomegranate, so Jungle Warrior casts first from the second cycle onward. Pomegranate should be all skill amp.

sources.title: 브라이트 시커 쿠키 스킬가속 연구
sources.titleEn: Bright Seeker Cookie skill haste research
sources.summaryEn: Modelled expected Bright Seeker damage (raid only) for 43 s fights, where the team dies with 17 s left, and 30 s fights, where it dies at the 30 s slam. The model uses three gear baselines, trades rune haste against rune skill amp 1:1, and finds a haste threshold at about 40 total. Crit rate and crit damage runes never beat haste or amp. Recommendations: whales run 8 haste lines, mid spenders target total skill haste 41–45, and F2P players who die at the 30 s slam should go skill amp and crit damage, because haste is negative in 30 s fights. The author's deck (Macaron and Cheesecake on 스증, everyone levelled down to Cheesecake's ATK, Jungle Warrior instead of Herb) scored 339G 975M at 912.73M (about 372x). After Seeker went to 8★ it scored 367G 994M. Last season's max was 250x, and a low-spec variant uses 딸크 and 방어구 수리특약.

sources.summaryEn: A tips post by 가방은 항상 두개 (written with Guild Conquest and dungeons in mind, but the mechanics are general). Synergy-giving cookies buff synergy receivers first (Pomegranate to Milk, Macaron to Milky Way), pet ATK buffs change the ATK ranking used for buff targeting, DR stacks multiplicatively (10% + 10% = 19%), and Skill Haste follows CD × 100 / (100 + haste). Debuff chance scales with focus over resist.

For PvP: Arena is per server and Rumble Arena is cross-server; current Arena/Rumble gear values evasion, crit chance, crit resist, Skill Haste and Skill AMP, built as either an evasion preset or a crit-resist preset (each also with Skill AMP, crit chance, accuracy). Arena refills one ticket every 2 hours; Rumble tickets refill to max at midnight; both have a free opponent refresh every 30 minutes. Rumble's passive changes every season, so its meta changes each season. Its dungeon screenshots show a '쟁탈전' tab in the dungeon menu.

sources.summaryEn: Season 1 live board at 2026-09-27T14:33:45Z (season start 2026-09-23T03:00:00Z, battle end 2026-10-08T03:00:00Z). Every row carries a 12-slot defense grid and three pets, but the game hides some defenders (crumb.gg's own note), so '?' slots are unknown, not empty; hidden-slot counts per team: {0: 16, 1: 3, 2: 6, 3: 51, 4: 24}. The top 100 all field the same twelve cookies with rare substitutions: Macaron, Oven Wanderer, Pinot Noir, Cheesecake, Pomegranate, Princess Bari, Milk (Pediatrician), Nameless Cake Hound, Ion, Cherry Cola, Herb, Moon Rabbit (Persimmon). No levels, stars, runes or gear are exposed.

The Rumble top 100 on the last day of Season 1 (06:32Z): #1 슈퍼땅콩 at 6912, #2 凱凱の餅乾軍團 6854, #3 인미 6422. 12 teams are fully revealed and 9 of them are exactly the standard 12; the others swap in Vampire, Skating Queen, Crepe, Rye, Tiger Lily or Rockstar. Herb shows on one top-10 team; half the top 10 carry Icy Birdie.

sources.title: CookieRun: Crumble hub (EOG)
sources.titleEn: EOG hub: Crumble Dungeon sections (global guild)
sources.summaryEn: Global guild EOG. The Dungeon throws the whole collection at the Holy Golden Drop, scores total damage, and deploys the top 40 by combat power first; lower the levels of unwanted cookies below the 40th-place cutoff (no need for Lv.1). Controlled test on one account, 2026-08-13: 403,708,109 with a 10-star Oven Wanderer and Cool Mint deployed, 574,531,356 with both benched (+42%); a younger account showed no change. Heals and shields go to the lowest-HP ally, so divers soak the sustain; supports follow divers forward, out of the ranged dealers' range. Pomegranate's beam is read as choosing by synergy match first, which EOG flags as unconfirmed. Its simulator section: no controls; attack range sets a cookie's slot and move speed its arrival; an arena-wide shockwave throws the team back four times; the boss raises its own damage reduction three times (EOG's reading of game data: stacks to five, one application per source), so a run is decided in its first thirteen seconds; damage spent on adds scores nothing. Pets' passive effects and Collection bonuses apply to every cookie.

sources.titleEn: ND러너: Holy Golden Drop dungeon 50G+ tips
sources.summaryEn: ND러너, before the 9/10 update. Run the dungeon at least once daily: participation crystals, daily top 10 pays pet tickets and research stones, bracket and weekly rewards pay XP and coins, score milestones pay crystals. The first 40 by power deploy together. Chargers such as Oven Wanderer pull aggro and move around the boss, and summoners spread the formation, so the range-limited buffs miss; the team should stay packed in the centre. Milk captain with Passion Pay; Milk must be top ATK counting the captain's +10%; Rapid Promotion second, also for Milk. Projectile Speed synergy recipients must be Lv.1 because they take the beam first (Milk excepted). Cheesecake is also Lv.1: its ATK buff replaced Milk's stacked ATK buff, which then restarted. Two options for the beam: Macaron and Figure at ATK #1-2 with dealers levelled below them, or let Milk and the main dealers take it.

researchRecords.question: There is a small, documented set of Guild Conquest teams that KR/Global top players use to reach ≥1T damage. For each one, the community sources name the cookie lineup, levels (including deliberate Lv.1 fillers), sugar runes, gear stats, pets and perks precisely enough that someone with every cookie could reproduce it.
researchRecords.lede: What Korean and global players run in Guild Conquest (길드 토벌전), from DCInside, the official Naver cafe and crumb.gg. Every claim links its post.
researchRecords.caveat: Snapshot of 2026-09-27, before Season 5's final boards. The 2.3–3.2T leaders haven't published teams. Best documented run: 1T 999G, Cherry deck, power unshown (≈3G).

researchRecords.question: For each PvP mode (regular Arena and Rumble Arena) there is a small documented set of top teams, and for each one the community sources name the lineup, formation, levels, stars, runes, gear, pets and the teams that beat it precisely enough that someone with every cookie could reproduce it and pick a counter.
researchRecords.seasonLabel: Arena Season 5 (live) · Rumble Arena Season 1 ends 2026-10-08; Season 2 to 2026-10-21
researchRecords.lede: What Korean and global players run in regular Arena (아레나) and Rumble Arena (와글와글 아레나). Every claim links to its post.
researchRecords.caveat: Snapshot of 2026-10-07, the eve of the 10-08 update (Lv.120 cap, Chardonnay, Rumble Season 2). Re-check after it.

researchRecords.question: For stage pushing (main stages and the Dimensional Rift past 328-30) there is a small documented set of teams, levels, runes, gear and pets that players use to clear the hardest stages at the lowest power, stated precisely enough to reproduce, including how play differs by stage type and what the recommended-power gate does to damage, in particular at the 35% and 15% damage brackets.
researchRecords.seasonLabel: Game 1.4.002 (after the 2026-09-23 stage easing) · Dimensional Rift season 1 (to 2026-10-08)
researchRecords.lede: What Korean players push main stages and the Dimensional Rift with while under-powered: the brackets, the 35% and 15% teams, and the per-boss swaps.
researchRecords.caveat: Main stages as of 2026-09-28, the Rift as of 2026-10-03. Main-stage 15% boss clears are claimed, never shown; Rift 15% screenshots reach level 18, never GingerCraven.

researchRecords.question: The Golden Drop encounter is Crumble Dungeon, a scored mode with documented rules, and players post scores with the lineup, levels, runes, gear and perks behind them precisely enough that the top-scoring builds can be named and reproduced by someone with every cookie.
researchRecords.seasonLabel: Game 1.4.002 (after the 2026-09-23 update) · Crumble Dungeon weekly boards closing Wednesdays 00:00 KST
researchRecords.lede: Crumble Dungeon (크럼블 던전), the daily score attack on the Holy Golden Drop (황금갓방울): the rules, the top scores and the lineup rules behind them.
researchRecords.caveat: Snapshot of 2026-09-28. No public ranking: scores are players' own screenshots and videos, one server at a time. Ranked by damage; the power shown is the whole collection's.

researchRecords.question: The community sources name every system that adds displayed team power in Cookie Run: Crumble, and give a cost and a power gain precise enough to rank the systems by power per unit of cost for a free and a paying player, and to say which moves a 2.2G team across the next stage-bracket line soonest.
researchRecords.seasonLabel: Game 1.4.002 (2026-09-23): plating to 25 with shatter restore, Gnome Lab to 110-2, the stage easing and the Dimensional Rift
researchRecords.lede: Team power (전투력) gates stages and the Dimensional Rift: what raises it, what each source costs free and paid, posted gains, and the spend order.
researchRecords.caveat: Snapshot of 2026-09-28. Few posted gains, all from DCInside; no public power formula. Crystal values rank package contents, not team power.

recordModes.lede: Regular, per-server Arena. Built Bari–Oven–Cherry Cola leads; the Rye deck is the value pick and the most-run lineup.
recordModes.caveat: crumb.gg's meta page is the only ladder data; its sample is unstated. Many 'Arena' screenshots are Rumble.

recordModes.lede: Rumble Arena (와글와글 아레나, 와레나): the cross-server arena. The top 100 still run one 12-cookie Oven–Bari team.
recordModes.caveat: Season 1's last day. Above 2,000 points levels and some defenders are hidden, so usage counts are lower bounds.

recordModes.lede: Main stages (328 chapters of 30 stages, cycling through eight zones) and the Dimensional Rift (seasonal, boss-only, opened 2026-09-23 for players past 328-30).
recordModes.caveat: Pre-easing clears (before 2026-09-23) were made against higher recommended power for 169-1 to 328-30; stage-clears.json marks the era of each.

recordModes.lede: Crumble Dungeon (크럼블 던전): every owned cookie fights the Holy Golden Drop in a timed run scored on damage, ranked daily and weekly per server.
recordModes.caveat: Fight length and boss patterns are the community wiki's, not official; the boss's damage-reduction steps are EOG's model. Entries a day unsettled: guides say three, lobbies show 5.

recordModes.lede: Team power growth: every system that raises displayed team power, with its cost, cap, posted gains and the spending order by account stage.
recordModes.caveat: Power is a gate for stages and the Rift, not a measure of strength: attack types and missing stats count more.

decks.ceilingText: Strongest when built: from Bari 7★ it usually beats Rye at equal spec. A server #1 defends with it at 4,106.
decks.summary: Three chargers dive the enemy Milk under Bari's Soul Guidance. Wins in the opening or not at all.
decks.formation: Owner screen dc:77158 (22.14M), a preset labelled 토벌; stars read from it. dc:78977's Arena attack card (16.4M, Bari 9★) has the same order.
decks.perks: Captain Milk, merc Lv.4: Armor Repair + Passion Pay. Health Insurance or Rapid Promotion to survive a mirror dive.
decks.rng: The opening decides it: the dive kills in about 3.5 s, or the deck runs dry.
decks.atkOrderNote: Only Milk's rank is fixed: ATK #1 for Passion Pay.

decks.ceilingText: 17.59M defense beat a 17–18M Rye deck 3 times of 3 (dc:75993).
decks.summary: Chain synergy feeds several sub-dealers; an isolated Schwarzwälder soaks Rye's first volley.
decks.formation: Only an opponent's defense card (mirrored), so no slots.
decks.perks: Not stated.

decks.summary: Talked about as the Rye counter: Crepe pushes Moon Rabbit, Espresso launches Rye. No screenshot exists; a reply calls it outdated (dc:79368).
decks.formation: Unknown.

decks.ceilingText: 14.38M beat 27.35M Bari–Oven–Cherry Cola at 14th, 3,809 trophies (dc:80136).
decks.summary: About 1,200–1,400 evasion makes attackers miss. Beats unprepared teams; loses to any accuracy preset.
decks.formation: Owner formation screen dc:72977 (11.13M, Season 4). dc:80136's 14.38M version has Vampire, Crepe, Hound, Moon Rabbit and Doughnut King.
decks.perks: Not stated.

decks.ceilingText: Server #1 at 14.58M on 2026-09-21. Still 14.7% of crumb.gg's Arena sample on 10-07, falling.
decks.summary: Season 4's meta: five ranged dealers for All Ammo Provided. Outclassed by the Rye and Bari decks.
decks.formation: From a defense log, so no slots.
decks.perks: Passion Pay + All Ammo Provided.

decks.ceilingText: The most-run Arena lineup: 13.0% of crumb.gg's sample (10-07). Beats Bari up to about 6★.
decks.summary: Value deck: Rye is the only carry and eleven cookies keep her alive. Wins the long fight if it survives Bari's opening.
decks.formation: Owner formation screen dc:74483 (13.87M). crumb.gg's meta page lists the same 12, pets and perks.
decks.perks: Captain Milk, merc Lv.4: Armor Repair (+10% DR, 3 tanks) + Passion Pay. crumb.gg lists the same pair.
decks.rng: Against Bari the first seconds decide: shields and heals land before the dive, or the team is deleted.
decks.atkOrderNote: Milk › Rye ≥ Pomegranate, so the beam lands on Rye. Check in battle.

decks.ceilingText: Beat the Skating + Grapevine Rye deck in the mirror (dc:80762). Loses to a fully set Bari deck.
decks.summary: The Rye one-carry core with Rockstar, whose shield lands inside Bari's first dive.
decks.formation: Owner's 'my attack team' card dc:81275; stars read from it. Perks not shown.
decks.perks: Captain Milk; Armor Repair needs three tanks (dc:77725).
decks.rng: Same opening roll as the Grapevine version, with a faster shield.
decks.atkOrderNote: Rye must be top-3 ATK; one player found her 4th (dc:80802).

decks.nameEn: Rye deck, Brightseeker + Doughnut King version
decks.ceilingText: An 8★ Rye with Brightseeker and Rockstar beat a 10★ Oven–Bari deck (dc:78543; mode not shown).
decks.summary: Brightseeker and Doughnut King replace Grapevine and Skating Queen. Only with a 5★+ Brightseeker.
decks.formation: Owner formation screen dc:76349 (16.56M).
decks.perks: Not stated; Rye decks run Armor Repair + Passion Pay.
decks.atkOrderNote: Rye gets just enough ATK to sit behind Milk and Brightseeker.

decks.summary: All but the buffers sit under Cheesecake's ATK, so she takes a beam and buffs Milk harder. From the skill-haste study's author.
The standard high-end deck since 9/20. Five Lv.1 fillers keep Pomegranate's +69% skill-amp beams on the carries; Cherry lines the team up inside Macaron's crit buff.
decks.formation: No move speed on any rune or gear piece: it breaks Cherry's line.
decks.perks: Leader Milk. 복지 (welfare): 열정페이 + 초고속승진, both on Milk. Mercenary squad Lv.4 opens the second welfare and third pet slots.
decks.rng: 1T in 1–2 of 10 runs at 1.74G, 1.1T occasionally. At 0.97G: 150× floor, 250–350× average, 400×+ after 14 h of macro.
decks.atkOrderNote: Order by 공격력 (ATK), not 전투력 (power); Pomegranate is outside it. Macaron with ATK runes moves to #3, above Skating Queen.

decks.summary: Full 40 plus exclusions and drop-at-will formation breakers (2026-09-13); no score posted. Cheesecake as 6th swings more between runs.
decks.perks: Not stated.
decks.atkOrderNote: Sixth: Macaron, Rye or Cheesecake; pets' ATK bonuses count toward the order.

decks.nameEn: ND러너 180G lineup: Macaron and Figure on the beam
decks.ceilingText: Record in the high 180s G at 14.14G total power; the run shown ends at 174.7G (2026-09-18, video; the record itself is stated, not shown).
decks.summary: Fullest published list: all 40 named, plus the Lv.1 cookies. Beam goes to buffers: Macaron and Figure rank ATK #1 and #2 after Milk; dealers sit below.
decks.perks: Milk captain; Passion Pay + Like A Family at mercenary Lv.4; Rapid Promotion at Lv.3; General Perks below that.
decks.rng: Normal run about 170G, poor one about 150G; every ticket goes to chasing the record.
decks.atkOrderNote: Milk takes the beam by synergy; Macaron and Figure rank ATK #1 and #2 below it. Simpler option: beam Milk and the main dealers (UF6zcIkbh_8).

decks.ceilingText: 379.3G at 15.58G total power, server 1st, 0.000 s left (2026-09-28, screenshot). Same rules: 159.6G at 8.57G (09-22), 43.2G at 3.51G (09-09).
decks.summary: Highest documented score. Milk captain at ATK #1; beam to Scorpion, then Figure. Supports at Lv.70 or below; chargers, summoners and beam thieves out.
decks.perks: Milk captain; Passion Pay + Rapid Promotion at mercenary Lv.4, Rapid Promotion alone at Lv.3.
decks.rng: Milk's arrival time decides the run; the author retunes levels when it lags.
decks.atkOrderNote: Only the top six ATK ranks matter; filler levels are free while those hold and exclusions stay out (dc:77306).

decks.ceilingText: 325.9G at 10.10G total power, server 1st, 0.000 s left (전치, 2026-09-27, screenshot). 221.4G at 9.23G (VART, video); VART claims 250G without Espresso.
decks.summary: Best score per power of any published lineup. Brightseeker ATK #2 takes the beam; Cheesecake 6th buffs Milk. 전치: 105.2G (3.74G) to 325.9G (10.10G).
decks.perks: Milk captain; Passion Pay + Rapid Promotion.
decks.rng: Milk must come out at once; changing Scorpion's runes broke VART's arrival again.
decks.atkOrderNote: The other 34 are lowered only until their power stays above the cookies left out (VART).

decks.summary: Pre-9/10: Cheesecake at Lv.1, since its ATK buff reset Milk's stacks. Otherwise ND러너's later 40, with Cheerleader, Coffee, Adventurer where Knight, Alchemist, Cheesecake went.
decks.perks: Milk captain; Passion Pay + Rapid Promotion.

decks.summary: Survival fallback when the team dies at the 30 s slam. Herb replaces Tiger Lily: 5 beams, so only ATK ranks 1–5 matter.
decks.perks: 열정페이 fixed, plus 초고속승진 (or a survival perk if the team is still dying).
decks.rng: Raises the floor more than the ceiling: one poster went 93× → 228× at 540M by fixing perks alone.

decks.summary: Week-2 ceiling deck, superseded by the level-down and Cherry decks. Needs a run where Cheesecake's buff hits only Milk and Scorpion.
decks.rng: The author played 4,230 runs in one season and still finished around 87×.

decks.summary: Melon Soda replaces Cherry; move speed on sugar runes forms the line. Higher peak per power when it forms, but tuning is per-account and unforgiving.
decks.formation: Move speed only from sugar runes, on Brightseeker, Pinot and Melon Soda. None on gear. The target is a single line (일렬).
decks.perks: 열정페이 + 초고속승진 on Milk.
decks.rng: Good alignment in about 3 of 4 runs. A 0.03 speed change can stop the line; one setup aligned on Galaxy, not on a Lenovo tablet.
decks.atkOrderNote: Scorpion sits exactly 7th, ahead of Melon Soda and Dark Choco.

decks.ceilingText: Rift level 8 at 15% (Werehound Princess, 12.15G Rift power, dc:77709); Witchberry–Herb variant: level 12 Cool Mint at 18.40G (dc:78353).
decks.summary: The post-easing stage core plus Scorpion and Pinot Noir for single-boss levels, all Lv.100. 카린 (328-30 at 4.00G) forced levels 8 and 12 at 15% with it.

decks.ceilingText: Rift level 12 at 15% (Cool Mint, 20.45G Rift power, dc:77612); the three trucks too, with Dark Choco in.
decks.summary: Devil's DEF shred, plus Dark Choco's when it comes in, forces damage through at 15%. Clears all but the Cake Hounds; Werehound Princess and GingerCraven hold.

decks.ceilingText: Rift level 18 at 15% (Werehound Princess, 29.73G Rift power, dc:78865): the furthest screenshot 15% clear. Also 롤로노아's level-19 and -23 trucks (nv:48662), Rift power unshown.
decks.summary: The Guild Conquest trick in the Rift: non-dealers levelled to 64–70 so the ATK-ordered buffs pile on Brightseeker, Rye and Cherry Cola. Conquest gear preset.

decks.ceilingText: Cake Hound Pack levels at 15%: level 11 at 17.80G Rift power (dc:78353, screenshot mid-fight at 4% HP) and level 6 (dc:77572, text).
decks.summary: For Cake Hound levels: Bari herds the pack so the pierce and area dealers hit it together. No Scorpion or Pinot Noir: there's no single boss.

decks.ceilingText: Rift levels 3–4 (Werehound Princess, truck), per a mid-ranked pusher. ND러너's level 11: Scorpion, Jungle Warrior, Dark Choco, Wind Archer, Macaron.
decks.summary: Partial Rift shred core: Scorpion poison to 20, DEF shred to 10, Devil against the truck, Tiger Lily, Octo Wasabi. Top guilds keep full decks private.

decks.ceilingText: #4 at 2,521 points on 2026-09-23; Bari dealt 2.78M (dc:73857).
decks.summary: Bari and Cherry Cola dive while Crepe pushes the enemy front together. Lost to every Rye deck met.
decks.formation: Only a battle-stats screen: four cookies and the grid aren't shown.

decks.ceilingText: 18.67M beat 15.35M: Bari 1.58M, Oven 1.21M (web:yt-_D4EvaRYdJY).
decks.summary: The charge core for Bari under 5★: Oven is her one soul target; Brightseeker and Rye fill in.
decks.formation: Seo Sinwoo's formation screen (18.68M).
decks.perks: Captain Milk: Armor Repair + Passion Pay; Crunch Mode if Bari keeps dying.

decks.ceilingText: The only attacker that broke dc:81227's Oven–Rye defense above 3,000 points.
decks.summary: The charge core with Vampire for Cherry Cola. About half the Bari decks ranked ~10–50 run it, by one observer.
decks.formation: One defense-log card (dc:81227 image 4), so no slots. Doughnut, Vampire and the first two pets read from sprites.
decks.perks: Not visible.

decks.ceilingText: 8.41M with 1,005 evasion beat 16.53M with 950 accuracy, then won 5 revenges (dc:74627).
decks.summary: Evasion gear plus Vampire's accuracy-down makes attackers miss. Hidden names stop opponents scouting it.
decks.formation: Attack preset 3. Slot row2-4 holds an unidentified water cookie, left out.
decks.perks: Not shown.

decks.ceilingText: 168th, 3,201 points at 30.46M; held 10 of 11 defenses above 3,000 (dc:81227).
decks.summary: Your Oven is the top-ATK, fastest cookie, so enemy chargers chase it and clump for Crepe and Rye.
decks.formation: Owner formation screen dc:81227 (preset 5, 30.46M).
decks.perks: Captain Oven: 3-tank Armor Repair + General Perks.
decks.rng: Relies on the poster's claim that over 90 of 100 Oven–Bari decks run no Skill Haste.
decks.atkOrderNote: Oven out-ATKs Milk on purpose so enemy chargers target it.

decks.summary: The pre-Bari ranged meta in Rumble. Charge decks delete it on contact even 3–4M down.
decks.formation: dc:73955's attack-team card (12.12M).
decks.perks: Not shown. dc:75153's version runs All Ammo Provided.

decks.nameEn: Rye anti-charge deck, Angel + Lime version

decks.formation: Owner formation screen dc:79238 (preset 4). Icy Birdie read from its sprite.

decks.atkOrderNote: ATK 2–3 lines on Rye keep her top-3.

decks.formation: 러너's formation screen (18.77M). crumb.gg's Rumble sample has this lineup at 3.6%.
decks.perks: VART's version: captain Milk, Passion Pay + Armor Repair.
decks.rng: Wins depend on the tanks surviving the first dive.
decks.atkOrderNote: Milk › Rye ≥ Pomegranate; Hound must out-ATK any Milky Way.

decks.nameEn: Rye anti-charge deck, Rockstar + Skating Queen version
decks.summary: Rockstar's shield and Skating Queen's buff carry Rye past the dive. Wins 12M down mid-ladder.
decks.formation: Owner formation screen dc:78308 (20.39M, Rye 8★); levels from the same player's battle screen dc:78990.
decks.perks: Not shown.
decks.rng: Loses to finished Bari at the very top.

decks.nameEn: Standard 12 (Oven–Bari charge core + support core + tank line)
decks.ceilingText: 9 of 11 attackers above 3,000 points in one log (dc:81227); 9 of 12 fully revealed top-100 teams on 10-07.
decks.summary: The Rumble top-100 team all season. The Season 1 Charge buff keeps three divers alive. Herb shows less often in the top 10.
decks.formation: Own attack panels dc:77491 and dc:77636 (all Lv.100), matching nv:45718's formation screen. crumb.gg grids sort by range, so they don't give slots.
decks.perks: Captain Milk. crumb.gg: Passion Pay + Rapid Promotion. Forums: Armor Repair + Passion Pay.

decks.atkOrderNote: Milk ATK #1. Routing the beam onto Bari means stripping Cherry Cola's ATK.

decks.perks: Armor Repair + Health Insurance (nv:45902).

decks.perks: Milk captain; 열정페이 + 초고속승진 at mercenary band Lv.4 (방어구 수리 특약 instead of 초고속승진 when survival fails).
decks.rng: Auto pathing: Cherry Cola runs ahead on auto. Bari's damage needs the boss exposed.

decks.perks: Milk captain (banner on the 4.00G clear); perks not shown.

decks.summary: ㅇㄹ's pre-easing GingerCraven deck, the documented low-power line: Scorpion poison to 20 by turn 3, Brightseeker on the boss, Lime and Ion for sustain.
decks.perks: 피감 + 체력 (damage reduction + HP).
decks.rng: Fear landing on the carries decides bottom-of-bracket clears; clears end with under 2 s left.

decks.nameEn: Brightseeker all-in-one deck with per-boss swaps (pre-easing)
decks.nameKr: 168 이후 All In One 단일 덱

runeBuilds.lines: Skill haste first (target 40–50 total with gear), then skill amp / crit dmg
runeBuilds.why: Haste keeps more of her 6 drones up before the 17 s wipe. Breakpoint near 40; top posters run 44.6–49.6. Gear gives ~27, runes ~15–22.
runeBuilds.disputed: Drones peel onto adds at 58.6 (dc:75934). Dying at 30 s? Skill amp beats haste. The 1.62T run: 4 haste + 2 skill amp at 10★ (dc:75462).

runeBuilds.why: Ranks into Pomegranate's beams on base ATK alone, so no ATK lines are needed.
Early guides used ATK% to hold her rank; current guides reroll to skill amp and let levels handle the order.
runeBuilds.disputed: alkapa.gg's raid tag recommends ATK% for Macaron, Skating Queen and Cheesecake. Every forum guide from 9/17 on says skill amp.

gearRecs.why: Crit dmg over crit rate: Macaron already pushes crit rate past 300%. Target at +15: skill amp 9%+, crit dmg 20%+. Skill amp beats displayed power.

gearRecs.substats: Skill amp + crit rate (arena)
gearRecs.why: In arena, enemy crit resistance eats crit rate, so crit rate is the arena pick. Several raid players run the arena set and lose damage.

gearRecs.substats: Skill haste + skill amp
gearRecs.why: The only slot group that rolls both of the raid's key stats. Max haste roll is +4.6 at plate +15.

gearRecs.substats: Damage reduction + HP
gearRecs.why: Crit resistance does nothing against the raid boss. Survive the 30 s slam and reach the 17 s wipe.

gearRecs.substats: Skill haste + damage reduction
gearRecs.why: Skill amp can't roll here. This group is the only one with both haste and damage reduction.

gearRecs.substats: 6 skill-haste lines + 6 skill-amp lines, then crit, then spare damage reduction
gearRecs.why: Each piece has a fixed option pool, so 6 of each is the ceiling across 12 pieces.

gearRecs.substats: No move speed, accuracy or focus
gearRecs.why: Move speed breaks the Cherry formation. The boss has low evasion and resistance, so accuracy and focus (stage stats) are dead lines.

gearRecs.substats: Separate raid preset (since 9/23)
gearRecs.why: Gear presets let raid gear stop doubling as arena gear. Posters describe the switch as a big jump.

gearRecs.substats: Skill AMP + crit rate
gearRecs.why: Crit rate beats crit DMG: opponents stack crit RES and Moon Rabbit cuts crit. One accuracy line optional.

gearRecs.substats: Skill Haste + Skill AMP (Rye and Brightseeker decks)
gearRecs.why: The only Skill Haste a Rye deck keeps: three lines.

gearRecs.substats: Skill AMP + crit rate (Bari decks)
gearRecs.why: Zero haste: Bari decks stake the fight on the first hit.

gearRecs.substats: Crit RES + DR
gearRecs.why: Most Arena damage crits. Past about 60% crit RES, DR is worth more.

gearRecs.substats: Skill Haste + crit RES (or DR)
gearRecs.why: Kept the sixth Skill Haste line while adding survival.
gearRecs.obsoleteReason: Swapping this haste for DR + crit RES won far more often; posters call six haste a scam.

gearRecs.substats: DR + crit RES (or DR + HP)
gearRecs.why: Replaced Skill Haste here: the team survives the opening far more often.

gearRecs.substats: Skill Haste on all six right-side pieces
gearRecs.why: Whoever cast first won, so heal and shield decks ran six haste lines.
gearRecs.obsoleteReason: Six haste lost the opening: 3 lines won more for a Rye deck, and Bari decks run none.

gearRecs.substats: Skill Haste lines: Bari decks 0, Rye and Brightseeker decks 3
gearRecs.why: Bari decks bet on the first hit; Rye decks trade haste for survival.

gearRecs.substats: About 230% unbuffed crit on a Bari deck
gearRecs.why: So the dive still crits through Moon Rabbit's debuff.

gearRecs.substats: No accuracy or focus (at most one accuracy line)
gearRecs.why: Typical evasion is about 650, so accuracy is dead weight outside evasion matchups.

gearRecs.substats: A separate arena preset
gearRecs.why: PvP lines show little power, so the preset looks weaker than it is.

gearRecs.substats: Evasion preset: evasion + crit RES and evasion + Skill Haste below, Focus + Skill Haste top-right, Skill AMP top-left
gearRecs.why: Evasion deck only: about 1,000–1,400 evasion. Loses to any accuracy preset.

gearRecs.substats: Attack evasion defenders on the stage preset (accuracy)
gearRecs.why: Accuracy cancels evasion. Names are visible, so remember who runs it.

gearRecs.substats: Wear the arena preset, not the stage preset
gearRecs.why: Players who forgot kept losing to equal-power opponents.

gearRecs.substats: Skill Haste on all six right-side pieces
gearRecs.why: Disputed: one Rye guide cut to three lines; the same author's newer guide runs six.

gearRecs.substats: Rye decks: Skill Haste only top-right (3 lines)
gearRecs.why: One guide's template, as in Arena: bottom-right goes DR + crit RES.

gearRecs.substats: Bari decks: no Skill Haste
gearRecs.why: Most Oven–Bari decks run none, one poster says. Posters guess hasted chargers dive before the buffs land.

gearRecs.substats: DR + crit RES, with RES (저항) this season
gearRecs.why: RES resists Moon Rabbit's debuff; DR beats crit RES against her crit cut.

gearRecs.substats: Two accuracy lines, on attack or defense
gearRecs.why: Evasion defenses spread higher up; two lines bounce them.

gearRecs.substats: Evasion set (about 1,000–1,500 evasion)
gearRecs.why: Hidden names stop opponents remembering it. Accuracy beats it.

gearRecs.substats: Top rankers attack on their stage (accuracy) preset
gearRecs.why: Reportedly, to beat evasion defenders. An observation, not a guide.

gearRecs.substats: Highest displayed power first
gearRecs.why: The bracket follows displayed power: roll for power ('순수 뻥투'), weapons and plates first; crit resist and crit dmg inflate most. Near-ties: Skill AMP, Haste or DR.

gearRecs.substats: Fill the stats the set lacks; don't stack accuracy/focus past the requirement
gearRecs.why: Balanced stats show more power: duplicates add little, missing stats a lot. An accuracy/focus-heavy set lowers power and can drop the bracket.

gearRecs.substats: Accuracy 900–1,000+, focus for debuffers
gearRecs.why: 900 accuracy is enough to 328 post-easing; ND러너 keeps about 1,000 past 300, calls 1,300 wasted. Take accuracy pieces that also add power.

gearRecs.substats: Skill AMP + crit rate (accuracy or focus if short)
gearRecs.why: Skill AMP is the must-have weapon line, then crit; stage enemies lack crit resistance, so one guide prefers crit rate. Accuracy or focus if short.

gearRecs.substats: Crit resist: power padding only
gearRecs.why: Useless in the fight (stage mobs don't crit) but inflates displayed power; keep it only when the bracket line is what's missing.

gearRecs.substats: Skill AMP + Skill Haste (accuracy or focus if short)
gearRecs.why: About three Skill Haste lines across accessories keep heals and buffs turning; one 240-30 GingerCraven clear needed 20+ from gear.

gearRecs.substats: Anything with the highest power (DR + HP when survival fails)
gearRecs.why: Armour is taken for power. When the front line dies (GingerCraven's burst before the easing), damage reduction and HP replace crit resist and evasion.

gearRecs.substats: A pure-power preset for the bracket line, a Skill Haste preset for auto
gearRecs.why: Two presets: all Skill Haste for auto, pure power when sitting just under a bracket line. The 301-27 15% clear used one named 뻥투.

gearRecs.substats: Arena-style preset: Skill Haste first, then Skill AMP, crit rate, crit damage, damage reduction; no accuracy or focus
gearRecs.why: Damage and cast rate: the boss isn't accuracy-gated like stages. Most top posts reuse their arena preset.

gearRecs.substats: One move-speed line
gearRecs.why: Milk arrives sooner: one poster went 50-60G to 75.4G on lower displayed power; others see Milk come out at once.

gearRecs.substats: The Guild Conquest preset
gearRecs.why: 서신우 saw no misses on his Conquest preset; 섬영's weekly best used a preset labelled 토벌.

gearRecs.substats: Higher displayed power
gearRecs.why: 뱅국 picks gear for power; other guides trade it for damage lines, and the move-speed case scored higher on less power.
